太典了。真能一键拖库的我没见过，一键能把自己送走的真不少吧。</div></div><div class="reply"><div class="reply-h"><span class="who anon">匿名</span><span class="floor">#3</span></div><div class="reply-b">还看到有人卖激活码，笑死啊</div></div></div></div></div><div class="reader-side" id="readerSide" style="display:none"></div></div></div></main><div class="keyhint" id="keyhint"><b>Esc / ←</b> <span class="lbl">返回</span><span class="sep">│</span><b>Space / j k</b> <span class="lbl">滚动</span><span class="sep">│</span><b>[ ]</b> <span class="lbl">上/下篇</span><span class="sep">│</span><b>?</b> <span class="lbl">帮助</span></div></div><div class="help" id="help"><div class="help-card"><div class="help-h">键位帮助<span class="right">? 或 Esc 关闭</span></div><div class="help-body"><div class="grp">浏览</div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">↑ ↓　j k</span><span class="desc">在列表里移动选择条</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">Enter　→</span><span class="desc">打开选中项</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">Esc　←</span><span class="desc">返回列表</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">1 - 7</span><span class="desc">切换板块筛选</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">0　`</span><span class="desc">回到最近主题</span></div><div class="grp">阅读</div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">[　p</span><span class="desc">上一篇</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">]　n</span><span class="desc">下一篇</span></div><div class="grp">滚动</div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">Tab　h l</span><span class="desc">切换左右栏（行动帖），滚动作用于当前栏</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">Space　b</span><span class="desc">向下／向上翻页</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">d　u</span><span class="desc">向下／向上半页</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">j　k　↑ ↓</span><span class="desc">滚动一行（阅读时）</span></div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">g　G</span><span class="desc">顶部／底部</span></div><div class="grp">通用</div><div class="help-row"><span class="key">?</span><span class="desc">开关此帮助</span></div></div></div></div><script>(function keyboard(arcade, opts) {
  const byId = (id) => document.getElementById(id), isReader = opts.mode === "reader", help = byId("help");
  function toggleHelp(on) {
    if (help)
      help.classList.toggle("on", on);
  }
  if (help)
    help.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target === help)
        toggleHelp(!1);
    });
  let sysTimer = null;
  function showSysNote() {
    const n = byId("sysnote");
    if (!n)
      return;
    n.classList.add("on");
    if (sysTimer)
      clearTimeout(sysTimer);
    sysTimer = setTimeout(() => n.classList.remove("on"), 3600);
  }
  let focusPane = "main";
  function sideVisible() {
    const s = byId("readerSide");
    return !!s && s.style.display !== "none";
  }
  function setFocus(p) {
    if (p === "side" && !sideVisible())
      return;
    focusPane = p;
    const m = byId("readerMain"), s = byId("readerSide");
    if (m)
      m.classList.toggle("focus", p === "main");
    if (s)
      s.classList.toggle("focus", p === "side");
    const label = byId("khPane");
    if (label)
      label.textContent = p === "side" ? "\u8BB0\u5F55" : "\u5E16\u5B50";
  }
  function scrollEl() {
    if (isReader)
      return focusPane === "side" ? byId("ircLog") : byId("readerMain");
    return byId("main");
  }
  function handleScroll(e) {
    const m = scrollEl();
    if (!m)
      return !1;
    const vp = m.clientHeight, page = vp - 48;
    switch (e.key) {
      case " ":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += e.shiftKey ? -page : page;
        return !0;
      case "b":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= page;
        return !0;
      case "d":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += vp / 2;
        return !0;
      case "u":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= vp / 2;
        return !0;
      case "g":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = 0;
        return !0;
      case "G":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
        return !0;
      case "PageDown":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += page;
        return !0;
      case "PageUp":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= page;
        return !0;
      case "Home":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = 0;
        return !0;
      case "End":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
        return !0;
      default:
        break;
    }
    if (isReader) {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "j") {
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += 44;
        return !0;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp" || e.key === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= 44;
        return !0;
      }
    }
    return !1;
  }
  let homeItems = [], homeSel = 0;
  function paintHome() {
    for (let i = 0;i < homeItems.length; i++)
      homeItems[i].classList.toggle("sel", i === homeSel);
  }
  function moveHome(d) {
    if (!homeItems.length)
      return;
    homeSel = (homeSel + d + homeItems.length) % homeItems.length;
    paintHome();
    homeItems[homeSel].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }
  function openHomeSel() {
    const el = homeItems[homeSel];
    if (!el)
      return;
    if (el.getAttribute("data-locked")) {
      showSysNote();
      return;
    }
    const href = el.getAttribute("data-href");
    if (href)
      arcade.navigate(href);
  }
  if (opts.mode === "list") {
    const rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#threadlist tr")), locks = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".base-f [data-locked]"));
    homeItems = rows.concat(locks);
    rows.forEach((tr, i) => {
      tr.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        paintHome();
      });
      tr.addEventListener("click", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        openHomeSel();
      });
    });
    locks.forEach((el) => {
      const i = homeItems.indexOf(el);
      el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        paintHome();
      });
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        paintHome();
        showSysNote();
      });
    });
    const pw = byId("paywall");
    if (pw)
      pw.addEventListener("click", showSysNote);
    paintHome();
  }
  let prevId = null, nextId = null, backHref = "/", navQuery = "";
  if (isReader) {
    const m = byId("readerMain"), s = byId("readerSide");
    if (m)
      m.addEventListener("mousedown", () => setFocus("main"));
    if (s)
      s.addEventListener("mousedown", () => setFocus("side"));
    setFocus("main");
    let b = "";
    try {
      b = new URL(arcade.url).searchParams.get("b") || "";
    } catch {
      b = "";
    }
    const lists = opts.lists || {};
    if (!lists[b])
      b = opts.ownBoardSlug || "";
    const list = lists[b] || [], idx = opts.id == null ? -1 : list.indexOf(opts.id);
    prevId = idx > 0 ? list[idx - 1] : null;
    nextId = idx >= 0 && idx < list.length - 1 ? list[idx + 1] : null;
    backHref = b === "recent" || b === "" ? "/" : `/b/${b}`;
    navQuery = b ? `?b=${b}` : "";
    const setNav = (elId, pid) => {
      const a = byId(elId);
      if (!a)
        return;
      if (pid == null) {
        a.classList.add("off");
        a.removeAttribute("href");
      } else {
        a.classList.remove("off");
        a.setAttribute("href", `/t/${pid}${navQuery}`);
      }
    };
    setNav("rdPrev", prevId);
    setNav("rdNext", nextId);
    const back = byId("rdBack");
    if (back)
      back.setAttribute("href", backHref);
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (help && help.classList.contains("on")) {
      if (e.key === "?" || e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleHelp(!1);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "?") {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleHelp(!0);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      if (isReader) {
        e.preventDefault();
        arcade.navigate(backHref);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (isReader && (e.key === "Tab" || e.key === "h" || e.key === "l")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (e.key === "h")
        setFocus("main");
      else if (e.key === "l") {
        if (sideVisible())
          setFocus("side");
      } else
        setFocus(focusPane === "main" ? "side" : "main");
      return;
    }
    if (handleScroll(e))
      return;
    if (opts.mode === "list") {
      const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || k === "j") {
        e.preventDefault();
        moveHome(1);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp" || k === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        moveHome(-1);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "ArrowRight") {
        e.preventDefault();
        openHomeSel();
        return;
      }
      const dig = opts.digits[e.key];
      if (dig) {
        e.preventDefault();
        arcade.navigate(dig);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "[" || e.key.toLowerCase() === "p") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (prevId != null)
        arcade.navigate(`/t/${prevId}${navQuery}`);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "]" || e.key.toLowerCase() === "n") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (nextId != null)
        arcade.navigate(`/t/${nextId}${navQuery}`);
    }
  });
})(window.arcade, {"mode":"reader","digits":{"0":"/","1":"/b/pinned","2":"/b/action","3":"/b/intel","4":"/b/tools","5":"/b/chat","6":"/b/jobs","`":"/"},"id":1826,"hasChannel":false,"ownBoardSlug":"tools","lists":{"recent":[1842,1841,1846,1835,1834,1840,1822,1837,1829],"pinned":[1842,1841],"action":[1837,1815],"intel":[1822,1838,1831],"tools":[1846,1834,1829,1826],"chat":[1835,1840,1845,1844,1825,1818],"jobs":[1832,1830,1816]}});</script></body>

data.title: #1829 写了个测试流量生成工具，练抓包的漂友自取｜driftnet
data.body_html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>#1829 写了个测试流量生成工具，练抓包的漂友自取｜driftnet</title>

<style>/* ============================================================
   driftnet — a Tor onion forum, rendered inside the in-game
   Browser app. A WEBPAGE, not a terminal program. Board = a
   FILTER over a shared thread base; a visitor sees only a few
   recent readable threads per board, the rest is a locked
   paywall. Static multi-page render — each thread its own URL.
   RED = hot/live/active. BLUE = system/info/navigational.
   CGA palette only in masthead + chat nick colors.
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --bg:#0a0a0b; --bg-1:#0c0c0e; --bg-2:#101013; --bg-3:#15151a; --edge:#000005;
  --bone:#cdc8b8; --bone-hi:#efe9d8; --muted:#82796a; --dim:#4f4840; --faint:#2c2a28;
  --line:#1c1c20; --line-2:#141417;
  --red:#c0392b; --red-hi:#d8503f; --red-dim:#7c2a22; --red-ink:#170707;
  --blue:#5b86d8; --blue-hi:#7ba0e8; --blue-dim:#2c3f6b; --blue-ink:#0a1020;
  --cyan:#4fb6b6; --amber:#c8a24b; --green:#6f9f5a; --white:#efe9d8;
  --row:20px;
}
*{ box-sizing:border-box; }
html,body{ margin:0; padding:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--bone); height:100%; }
body{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono','Noto Sans SC',ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:13.5px; line-height:var(--row); font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility; font-variant-ligatures:none;
}
body::after{
  content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:90;
  background:radial-gradient(132% 112% at 50% 28%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 64%, rgba(0,0,0,.40) 100%);
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;
}
.acc{ color:var(--red); } .bone{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.muted{ color:var(--muted); } .dim{ color:var(--dim); }
.cyan{ color:var(--cyan); } .amber{ color:var(--amber); }
.green{ color:var(--green); } .num{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
a{ color:var(--blue); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; }
a:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); border-bottom-color:var(--blue-dim); }

.page{ height:100vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  background:radial-gradient(120% 56% at 50% -8%, rgba(54,52,58,.045), rgba(0,0,0,0) 56%), var(--bg);
  overflow:hidden; }
.main{ flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden; }
.col{ width:1040px; max-width:100%; margin:0 auto; padding:14px 18px 22px; }
pre.art{ margin:0; font:inherit; line-height:var(--row); white-space:pre; }

.panel{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-1); overflow:hidden; }
.panel + .panel{ margin-top:13px; }
.ph-bar{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--dim);
  background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.ph-bar .ttl{ color:var(--muted); }
.ph-bar .ttl .bd{ color:var(--blue); }
.ph-bar .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }

.masthead{ margin-top:2px; padding-bottom:2px; }

/* ===================== BOARD MENU (filter) ============== */
.menu{ margin-top:13px; }
.lightbar{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; padding:5px 7px; gap:2px; }
.lb{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:0 10px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row);
  font-size:12.5px; color:var(--bone); cursor:pointer; border:1px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap;
}
.lb .hot{ color:var(--red); }
.lb .cnt{ color:var(--dim); font-size:11px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.lb:hover{ background:var(--bg-3); }
.lb.sel{ background:var(--red); color:var(--red-ink); }
.lb.sel .hot{ color:var(--red-ink); } .lb.sel .cnt{ color:#3a1410; }
.lb, .lb:hover{ border-bottom-color:transparent; }

/* ===================== THREAD LIST ===================== */
.base{ margin-top:13px; }
table.threads{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px; table-layout:fixed; }
table.threads thead td{
  color:var(--dim); font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.04em; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row);
  padding:0 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-2);
}
table.threads tbody td{
  padding:0 12px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);
  vertical-align:middle; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
table.threads tbody tr:last-child td{ border-bottom:0; }
table.threads tbody tr{ cursor:pointer; }
table.threads tbody tr:hover td, table.threads tbody tr.sel td{ background:var(--bg-3); }
table.threads tbody tr.sel td{ box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--red); }
table.threads tbody tr.sel .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }

.c-no{ width:52px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.c-bd{ width:74px; }
.c-title{ color:var(--bone); }
.c-meta{ width:104px; color:var(--muted); text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.c-by{ width:84px; color:var(--muted); text-align:right; }
.c-act{ width:78px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; }

.bd{ color:var(--blue); }
.tag{ color:var(--dim); }
.tag.pin{ color:var(--red); } .tag.hot{ color:var(--red); }

tr.live .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.liveflag{ color:var(--red); font-size:11px; margin-left:9px; border:1px solid var(--red-dim); border-radius:2px; padding:0 5px; }
.liveflag .d{ color:var(--red); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){ .liveflag .d{ animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } }
@keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.32} }

/* guest notice — BLUE system voice */
.guestnote{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px;
  background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue);
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;
}
.guestnote .sig{ color:var(--blue); flex:0 0 auto; }
.guestnote .t{ color:var(--muted); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }

/* ---- PAYWALL: redacted unreadable threads, can't even read titles ---- */
.paywall{ position:relative; border-top:1px solid var(--line-2); cursor:not-allowed; user-select:none; overflow:hidden; }
.pw-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 12px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); }
.pw-row .pw-no{ width:52px; }
.pw-bar{ color:var(--faint); letter-spacing:-1px; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; filter:blur(1.1px); }
.pw-bar.t{ flex:1; }
.pw-bar.s{ width:120px; text-align:right; flex:0 0 auto; }
.pw-row.r1{ opacity:.62 } .pw-row.r2{ opacity:.40 } .pw-row.r3{ opacity:.24 } .pw-row.r4{ opacity:.12 }
.pw-veil{
  position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; padding-bottom:9px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12,12,14,0) 0%, rgba(12,12,14,.55) 52%, var(--bg-1) 92%);
}
.pw-veil .lock{ color:var(--blue); font-size:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; }
.pw-veil .lock .pad{ font-size:11px; }
.pw-veil .lock .sub{ color:var(--dim); }

.base-f{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11px; color:var(--dim);
  background:var(--bg-2); border-top:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;
}
.base-f .pg{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.base-f .pg .lbl{ padding-right:4px; }
.base-f .pg span{ padding:0 5px; }
.base-f .pg .on{ background:var(--red); color:var(--red-ink); }
.base-f .pg .lock{ color:var(--faint); cursor:not-allowed; }
.base-f .pg .lock:hover{ color:var(--dim); }
.base-f .pg .lock .pad{ font-size:10px; padding-right:2px; }
.base-f .older{ color:var(--faint); cursor:not-allowed; }
.base-f .older:hover{ color:var(--dim); }
.base-f .older .pad{ font-size:10px; padding-right:3px; }
.base-f .lock.sel, .base-f .older.sel{ color:var(--blue); box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue-dim); }
.base-f .lock.sel .pad, .base-f .older.sel .pad{ color:var(--blue); }
.base-f .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }

/* in-lore SYSTEM notice */
.sysnote{
  position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:64px; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); z-index:115;
  max-width:min(560px,92vw); background:var(--bg-1); border:1px solid var(--blue-dim);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--edge), 0 18px 50px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.92);
  color:var(--blue); font-size:12.5px; line-height:19px; padding:9px 14px 10px;
  opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .14s ease-out, transform .14s ease-out;
}
.sysnote.on{ opacity:1; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
.sysnote .sig{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.sysnote .body{ color:var(--bone); display:block; margin-top:2px; }

/* ===================== READER ========================== */
.crumb{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 2px; margin-top:6px; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; }
.crumb a.back{ color:var(--blue); border:0; cursor:pointer; }
.crumb a.back:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.crumb .here{ color:var(--dim); }

  const byId = (id) => document.getElementById(id), isReader = opts.mode === "reader", help = byId("help");
  function toggleHelp(on) {

  let sysTimer = null;
  function showSysNote() {

    if (sysTimer)

  let focusPane = "main";

  }

    if (s)
      s.classList.toggle("focus", p === "side");

      label.textContent = p === "side" ? "\u8BB0\u5F55" : "\u5E16\u5B50";

    if (isReader)
      return focusPane === "side" ? byId("ircLog") : byId("readerMain");
    return byId("main");
  }
  function handleScroll(e) {
    const m = scrollEl();
    if (!m)
      return !1;
    const vp = m.clientHeight, page = vp - 48;
    switch (e.key) {
      case " ":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += e.shiftKey ? -page : page;
        return !0;
      case "b":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= page;
        return !0;
      case "d":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += vp / 2;
        return !0;
      case "u":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= vp / 2;
        return !0;
      case "g":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = 0;
        return !0;
      case "G":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
        return !0;
      case "PageDown":

        return !0;

    }
    const href = el.getAttribute("data-href");

  if (opts.mode === "list") {
    const rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#threadlist tr")), locks = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".base-f [data-locked]"));

    rows.forEach((tr, i) => {

        homeSel = i;

        paintHome();

  let prevId = null, nextId = null, backHref = "/", navQuery = "";
  if (isReader) {

    if (m)

    } catch {

    }
    const lists = opts.lists || {};
    if (!lists[b])

<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>#1830 有人接身份重建单吗｜driftnet</title>

<style>/* ============================================================
   driftnet — a Tor onion forum, rendered inside the in-game
   Browser app. A WEBPAGE, not a terminal program. Board = a
   FILTER over a shared thread base; a visitor sees only a few
   recent readable threads per board, the rest is a locked
   paywall. Static multi-page render — each thread its own URL.
   RED = hot/live/active. BLUE = system/info/navigational.
   CGA palette only in masthead + chat nick colors.
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --bg:#0a0a0b; --bg-1:#0c0c0e; --bg-2:#101013; --bg-3:#15151a; --edge:#000005;
  --bone:#cdc8b8; --bone-hi:#efe9d8; --muted:#82796a; --dim:#4f4840; --faint:#2c2a28;
  --line:#1c1c20; --line-2:#141417;
  --red:#c0392b; --red-hi:#d8503f; --red-dim:#7c2a22; --red-ink:#170707;
  --blue:#5b86d8; --blue-hi:#7ba0e8; --blue-dim:#2c3f6b; --blue-ink:#0a1020;
  --cyan:#4fb6b6; --amber:#c8a24b; --green:#6f9f5a; --white:#efe9d8;
  --row:20px;
}
*{ box-sizing:border-box; }
html,body{ margin:0; padding:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--bone); height:100%; }
body{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono','Noto Sans SC',ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:13.5px; line-height:var(--row); font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility; font-variant-ligatures:none;
}
body::after{
  content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:90;
  background:radial-gradient(132% 112% at 50% 28%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 64%, rgba(0,0,0,.40) 100%);
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;
}
.acc{ color:var(--red); } .bone{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.muted{ color:var(--muted); } .dim{ color:var(--dim); }
.cyan{ color:var(--cyan); } .amber{ color:var(--amber); }
.green{ color:var(--green); } .num{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
a{ color:var(--blue); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; }
a:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); border-bottom-color:var(--blue-dim); }

.page{ height:100vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  background:radial-gradient(120% 56% at 50% -8%, rgba(54,52,58,.045), rgba(0,0,0,0) 56%), var(--bg);
  overflow:hidden; }
.main{ flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden; }
.col{ width:1040px; max-width:100%; margin:0 auto; padding:14px 18px 22px; }
pre.art{ margin:0; font:inherit; line-height:var(--row); white-space:pre; }

.panel{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-1); overflow:hidden; }
.panel + .panel{ margin-top:13px; }
.ph-bar{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--dim);
  background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.ph-bar .ttl{ color:var(--muted); }
.ph-bar .ttl .bd{ color:var(--blue); }
.ph-bar .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }

.masthead{ margin-top:2px; padding-bottom:2px; }

/* ===================== BOARD MENU (filter) ============== */
.menu{ margin-top:13px; }
.lightbar{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; padding:5px 7px; gap:2px; }
.lb{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:0 10px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row);
  font-size:12.5px; color:var(--bone); cursor:pointer; border:1px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap;
}
.lb .hot{ color:var(--red); }
.lb .cnt{ color:var(--dim); font-size:11px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.lb:hover{ background:var(--bg-3); }
.lb.sel{ background:var(--red); color:var(--red-ink); }
.lb.sel .hot{ color:var(--red-ink); } .lb.sel .cnt{ color:#3a1410; }
.lb, .lb:hover{ border-bottom-color:transparent; }

/* ===================== THREAD LIST ===================== */
.base{ margin-top:13px; }
table.threads{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px; table-layout:fixed; }
table.threads thead td{
  color:var(--dim); font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.04em; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row);
  padding:0 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-2);
}
table.threads tbody td{
  padding:0 12px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);
  vertical-align:middle; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
table.threads tbody tr:last-child td{ border-bottom:0; }
table.threads tbody tr{ cursor:pointer; }
table.threads tbody tr:hover td, table.threads tbody tr.sel td{ background:var(--bg-3); }
table.threads tbody tr.sel td{ box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--red); }
table.threads tbody tr.sel .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }

.c-no{ width:52px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.c-bd{ width:74px; }
.c-title{ color:var(--bone); }
.c-meta{ width:104px; color:var(--muted); text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.c-by{ width:84px; color:var(--muted); text-align:right; }
.c-act{ width:78px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; }

.bd{ color:var(--blue); }
.tag{ color:var(--dim); }
.tag.pin{ color:var(--red); } .tag.hot{ color:var(--red); }

tr.live .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.liveflag{ color:var(--red); font-size:11px; margin-left:9px; border:1px solid var(--red-dim); border-radius:2px; padding:0 5px; }
.liveflag .d{ color:var(--red); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){ .liveflag .d{ animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } }
@keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.32} }

/* guest notice — BLUE system voice */
.guestnote{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px;
  background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue);
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;
}
.guestnote .sig{ color:var(--blue); flex:0 0 auto; }
.guestnote .t{ color:var(--muted); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }

/* ---- PAYWALL: redacted unreadable threads, can't even read titles ---- */
.paywall{ position:relative; border-top:1px solid var(--line-2); cursor:not-allowed; user-select:none; overflow:hidden; }
.pw-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 12px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); }
.pw-row .pw-no{ width:52px; }
.pw-bar{ color:var(--faint); letter-spacing:-1px; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; filter:blur(1.1px); }
.pw-bar.t{ flex:1; }
.pw-bar.s{ width:120px; text-align:right; flex:0 0 auto; }
.pw-row.r1{ opacity:.62 } .pw-row.r2{ opacity:.40 } .pw-row.r3{ opacity:.24 } .pw-row.r4{ opacity:.12 }
.pw-veil{
  position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; padding-bottom:9px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12,12,14,0) 0%, rgba(12,12,14,.55) 52%, var(--bg-1) 92%);
}
.pw-veil .lock{ color:var(--blue); font-size:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; }
.pw-veil .lock .pad{ font-size:11px; }
.pw-veil .lock .sub{ color:var(--dim); }

.base-f{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11px; color:var(--dim);
  background:var(--bg-2); border-top:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;
}
.base-f .pg{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.base-f .pg .lbl{ padding-right:4px; }
.base-f .pg span{ padding:0 5px; }
.base-f .pg .on{ background:var(--red); color:var(--red-ink); }
.base-f .pg .lock{ color:var(--faint); cursor:not-allowed; }
.base-f .pg .lock:hover{ color:var(--dim); }
.base-f .pg .lock .pad{ font-size:10px; padding-right:2px; }
.base-f .older{ color:var(--faint); cursor:not-allowed; }
.base-f .older:hover{ color:var(--dim); }
.base-f .older .pad{ font-size:10px; padding-right:3px; }
.base-f .lock.sel, .base-f .older.sel{ color:var(--blue); box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue-dim); }
.base-f .lock.sel .pad, .base-f .older.sel .pad{ color:var(--blue); }
.base-f .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }

/* in-lore SYSTEM notice */
.sysnote{
  position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:64px; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); z-index:115;
  max-width:min(560px,92vw); background:var(--bg-1); border:1px solid var(--blue-dim);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--edge), 0 18px 50px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.92);
  color:var(--blue); font-size:12.5px; line-height:19px; padding:9px 14px 10px;
  opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .14s ease-out, transform .14s ease-out;
}
.sysnote.on{ opacity:1; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
.sysnote .sig{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.sysnote .body{ color:var(--bone); display:block; margin-top:2px; }

/* ===================== READER ========================== */
.crumb{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 2px; margin-top:6px; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; }
.crumb a.back{ color:var(--blue); border:0; cursor:pointer; }
.crumb a.back:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.crumb .here{ color:var(--dim); }

.msg{ margin-top:8px; }
.msg-head{ padding:7px 14px 8px; font-size:12px; background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; gap:1px 14px; }
.msg-head .k{ color:var(--dim); }
.msg-head .v{ color:var(--bone); }
.msg-head .v .sp{ display:inline-block; width:12px; }
.msg-head .v.subj{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.msg-head .v .tag{ color:var(--red); } .msg-head .v .op{ color:var(--red); } .msg-head .v .on{ color:var(--red); }
.msg-head .v .bd{ color:var(--blue); } .msg-head .v .rank{ color:var(--dim); }
.msg-body{ padding:13px 16px 16px; font-size:13.5px; line-height:22px; color:var(--bone); white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; max-width:76ch; background:var(--bg-1); }
.gt{ color:var(--green); }                 /* greentext */
.qref{ color:var(--blue); }                /* >> quote ref */
.msg-foot{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11px; color:var(--dim); background:var(--bg-2); border-top:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; }
.msg-foot .k{ color:var(--muted); } .msg-foot .v{ color:var(--bone); } .msg-foot .on{ color:var(--red); }
.msg-foot .nav{ margin-left:auto; display:flex; gap:16px; }
.msg-foot .nav a{ color:var(--blue); border:0; cursor:pointer; }
.msg-foot .nav a:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.msg-foot .nav a.off{ color:var(--faint); cursor:default; }

/* ---- replies ---- */
.replies{ margin-top:13px; }
.replies .rh{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--dim); background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); }
.replies .rh b{ color:var(--muted); font-weight:400; }
.reply{ padding:6px 14px 9px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); }
.reply:last-child{ border-bottom:0; }
.reply-h{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--dim); display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:9px; }
.reply-h .who{ color:var(--bone); }
.reply-h .who.anon{ color:var(--muted); }
.reply-h .rank{ color:var(--dim); }
.reply-h .floor{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.reply-b{ margin-top:2px; font-size:13px; line-height:21px; color:var(--bone); white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; max-width:76ch; }
.replies-closed{ padding:8px 14px 10px; font-size:12px; color:var(--dim); }
.reply-h .who.df{ color:var(--blue); }

/* ---- bounty install affordance (sits under the OP body) ---- */
.bounty-act{ margin:11px 16px 2px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid var(--red-dim); background:var(--bg-2); font-size:12.5px; line-height:19px; }
.bounty-act .lbl{ color:var(--dim); }
.bounty-act .install{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; color:var(--red); cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--red-dim); padding:0 11px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); background:var(--red-ink); }
.bounty-act .install:hover{ color:var(--red-hi); border-color:var(--red); background:#220a06; }
.bounty-act .install.busy{ color:var(--dim); border-color:var(--line); background:var(--bg-3); cursor:default; }
.bounty-act .install .b{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.bounty-act.done{ border-color:var(--blue-dim); }
.bounty-act .ok{ color:var(--blue); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
.bounty-act .ok .sig{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.bounty-act .ok .where{ color:var(--muted); }

/* ===================== irssi IRC CLIENT =============== */
.irc{ margin-top:13px; background:var(--bg-1); }
.irc-top{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 10px; font-size:12px; background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); color:var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; }
.irc-top .br{ color:var(--dim); } .irc-top .chan{ color:var(--bone); }
.irc-top .topic{ color:var(--muted); padding-left:9px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.irc-grid{ display:flex; min-height:360px; }
.irc-buf{ flex:0 0 152px; border-right:1px solid var(--line-2); background:var(--bg-1); padding:4px 0; font-size:12px; }
.buf-h{ color:var(--dim); font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.04em; padding:0 11px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); }
.buf{ padding:0 11px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:var(--muted); cursor:default; }
.buf .n{ color:var(--dim); width:11px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.buf.on{ background:var(--bg-3); color:var(--bone); box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--red); }
.buf.on .n{ color:var(--red); } .buf .act{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--red); font-size:10px; }
.irc-mid{ flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.irc-log{ padding:7px 12px 9px; font-size:12.5px; line-height:20px; }
.irc-top .arch{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--dim); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:2px; padding:0 6px; font-size:11px; }
/* thread reader = two columns for channel threads: post+comments | transcript */
.reader-cols{ display:flex; gap:13px; align-items:flex-start; margin-top:8px; }
/* each column is viewport-bounded and scrolls on its own (tmux/lazygit panes) */
.reader-main{ flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; max-height:calc(100vh - 96px); overflow-y:auto; outline:1px solid transparent; outline-offset:-1px; }
.reader-side{ flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; }
.reader-side .chanlog{ margin-top:0; outline:1px solid transparent; outline-offset:-1px; }
.reader-side .irc-log{ max-height:calc(100vh - 174px); overflow-y:auto; }
/* focused pane gets an accent outline */
.reader-main.focus{ outline-color:var(--red-dim); }
.reader-side.focus .chanlog{ outline-color:var(--red-dim); }
/* first panel sits flush inside the pane (no gap under the focus outline) */
.reader-main .msg{ margin-top:0; }
/* archived channel panel (single column, lives in the right reader column) */
.irc-top .topic{ flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0; }
.chan-meta{ padding:3px 12px; min-height:var(--row); line-height:19px; font-size:11.5px; background:var(--bg-1); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:2px 9px; }
.chan-meta .k{ color:var(--dim); }
.chan-meta .cp.op{ font-weight:500; }
.irc-foot{ padding:3px 12px; min-height:var(--row); line-height:18px; font-size:11px; color:var(--dim); background:var(--bg-2); border-top:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:2px 16px; }
.irc-foot .k{ color:var(--muted); }
.irc-foot .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }
.chanflag{ color:var(--blue); font-size:11px; margin-left:9px; border:1px solid var(--blue-dim); border-radius:2px; padding:0 5px; }
tr.chan .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.ln{ display:flex; white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){ .ln{ animation:appear .16s ease-out both; } }
@keyframes appear{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(2px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none} }
.ln .t{ color:var(--dim); flex:0 0 auto; width:44px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.ln .n{ flex:0 0 90px; text-align:right; padding-right:9px; }
.ln .m{ flex:1; min-width:0; color:var(--bone); }
.ln .m .link{ color:var(--cyan); } .ln .m .geo{ color:var(--amber); } .ln .m .emo{ color:var(--amber); }
.ln.sys .t{ color:var(--dim); } .ln.sys .n{ color:var(--dim); } .ln.sys .m{ color:var(--muted); } .ln.sys .n .pre{ color:var(--green); }
.n-canary{ color:var(--red); } .n-echo{ color:var(--cyan); } .n-backd00r{ color:var(--amber); } .n-004{ color:var(--green); } .n-static{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.irc-names{ flex:0 0 146px; border-left:1px solid var(--line-2); background:var(--bg-1); padding:4px 0; font-size:12px; }

  const byId = (id) => document.getElementById(id), isReader = opts.mode === "reader", help = byId("help");
  function toggleHelp(on) {
    if (help)
      help.classList.toggle("on", on);
  }
  if (help)
    help.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target === help)
        toggleHelp(!1);
    });
  let sysTimer = null;
  function showSysNote() {
    const n = byId("sysnote");
    if (!n)
      return;
    n.classList.add("on");
    if (sysTimer)
      clearTimeout(sysTimer);
    sysTimer = setTimeout(() => n.classList.remove("on"), 3600);
  }
  let focusPane = "main";
  function sideVisible() {
    const s = byId("readerSide");
    return !!s && s.style.display !== "none";
  }
  function setFocus(p) {
    if (p === "side" && !sideVisible())
      return;
    focusPane = p;
    const m = byId("readerMain"), s = byId("readerSide");
    if (m)
      m.classList.toggle("focus", p === "main");
    if (s)
      s.classList.toggle("focus", p === "side");
    const label = byId("khPane");
    if (label)
      label.textContent = p === "side" ? "\u8BB0\u5F55" : "\u5E16\u5B50";
  }
  function scrollEl() {
    if (isReader)
      return focusPane === "side" ? byId("ircLog") : byId("readerMain");
    return byId("main");
  }
  function handleScroll(e) {
    const m = scrollEl();
    if (!m)
      return !1;
    const vp = m.clientHeight, page = vp - 48;
    switch (e.key) {
      case " ":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += e.shiftKey ? -page : page;
        return !0;
      case "b":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= page;
        return !0;
      case "d":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += vp / 2;
        return !0;
      case "u":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= vp / 2;
        return !0;
      case "g":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = 0;
        return !0;
      case "G":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
        return !0;
      case "PageDown":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += page;
        return !0;
      case "PageUp":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= page;
        return !0;
      case "Home":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = 0;
        return !0;
      case "End":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
        return !0;
      default:
        break;
    }
    if (isReader) {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "j") {
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += 44;
        return !0;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp" || e.key === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= 44;
        return !0;
      }
    }
    return !1;
  }
  let homeItems = [], homeSel = 0;
  function paintHome() {
    for (let i = 0;i < homeItems.length; i++)
      homeItems[i].classList.toggle("sel", i === homeSel);
  }
  function moveHome(d) {
    if (!homeItems.length)
      return;
    homeSel = (homeSel + d + homeItems.length) % homeItems.length;
    paintHome();
    homeItems[homeSel].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }
  function openHomeSel() {
    const el = homeItems[homeSel];
    if (!el)
      return;
    if (el.getAttribute("data-locked")) {
      showSysNote();
      return;
    }
    const href = el.getAttribute("data-href");
    if (href)
      arcade.navigate(href);
  }
  if (opts.mode === "list") {
    const rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#threadlist tr")), locks = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".base-f [data-locked]"));
    homeItems = rows.concat(locks);
    rows.forEach((tr, i) => {
      tr.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        paintHome();
      });
      tr.addEventListener("click", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        openHomeSel();
      });
    });
    locks.forEach((el) => {
      const i = homeItems.indexOf(el);
      el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        paintHome();
      });
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        paintHome();
        showSysNote();
      });
    });
    const pw = byId("paywall");
    if (pw)
      pw.addEventListener("click", showSysNote);
    paintHome();
  }
  let prevId = null, nextId = null, backHref = "/", navQuery = "";
  if (isReader) {
    const m = byId("readerMain"), s = byId("readerSide");
    if (m)
      m.addEventListener("mousedown", () => setFocus("main"));
    if (s)
      s.addEventListener("mousedown", () => setFocus("side"));
    setFocus("main");
    let b = "";
    try {
      b = new URL(arcade.url).searchParams.get("b") || "";
    } catch {
      b = "";
    }
    const lists = opts.lists || {};
    if (!lists[b])
      b = opts.ownBoardSlug || "";
    const list = lists[b] || [], idx = opts.id == null ? -1 : list.indexOf(opts.id);
    prevId = idx > 0 ? list[idx - 1] : null;
    nextId = idx >= 0 && idx < list.length - 1 ? list[idx + 1] : null;
    backHref = b === "recent" || b === "" ? "/" : `/b/${b}`;
    navQuery = b ? `?b=${b}` : "";
    const setNav = (elId, pid) => {
      const a = byId(elId);
      if (!a)
        return;
      if (pid == null) {
        a.classList.add("off");
        a.removeAttribute("href");
      } else {
        a.classList.remove("off");
        a.setAttribute("href", `/t/${pid}${navQuery}`);
      }
    };
    setNav("rdPrev", prevId);
    setNav("rdNext", nextId);
    const back = byId("rdBack");
    if (back)
      back.setAttribute("href", backHref);
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (help && help.classList.contains("on")) {
      if (e.key === "?" || e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleHelp(!1);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "?") {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleHelp(!0);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      if (isReader) {
        e.preventDefault();
        arcade.navigate(backHref);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (isReader && (e.key === "Tab" || e.key === "h" || e.key === "l")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (e.key === "h")
        setFocus("main");
      else if (e.key === "l") {
        if (sideVisible())
          setFocus("side");
      } else
        setFocus(focusPane === "main" ? "side" : "main");
      return;
    }
    if (handleScroll(e))
      return;
    if (opts.mode === "list") {
      const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || k === "j") {
        e.preventDefault();
        moveHome(1);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp" || k === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        moveHome(-1);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "ArrowRight") {
        e.preventDefault();
        openHomeSel();
        return;
      }
      const dig = opts.digits[e.key];
      if (dig) {
        e.preventDefault();
        arcade.navigate(dig);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "[" || e.key.toLowerCase() === "p") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (prevId != null)
        arcade.navigate(`/t/${prevId}${navQuery}`);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "]" || e.key.toLowerCase() === "n") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (nextId != null)
        arcade.navigate(`/t/${nextId}${navQuery}`);
    }
  });
})(window.arcade, {"mode":"reader","digits":{"0":"/","1":"/b/pinned","2":"/b/action","3":"/b/intel","4":"/b/tools","5":"/b/chat","6":"/b/jobs","`":"/"},"id":1830,"hasChannel":false,"ownBoardSlug":"jobs","lists":{"recent":[1842,1841,1846,1835,1834,1840,1822,1837,1829],"pinned":[1842,1841],"action":[1837,1815],"intel":[1822,1838,1831],"tools":[1846,1834,1829,1826],"chat":[1835,1840,1845,1844,1825,1818],"jobs":[1832,1830,1816]}});</script></body>

原帖好像还被那个楼主自己删了，怎么回事</div></div><div class="reply"><div class="reply-h"><span class="who">tideglass</span><span class="rank">声望 443</span><span class="floor">#4</span></div><div class="reply-b">滨海的网络监测公开的部分只有骨干网，蓝湾企业侧和 CDN 那边的数据应该还能细一点。我回头找找。</div></div><div class="reply"><div class="reply-h"><span class="who anon">匿名</span><span class="floor">#5</span></div><div class="reply-b">这么诡异？我当时还真以为是运营商又抽风了</div></div><div class="reply"><div class="reply-h"><span class="who anon">匿名</span><span class="floor">#6</span></div><div class="reply-b">嗯……这么看来我觉得不像网络异常和脑死亡事件互相影响，更像是同一个过程留下的两个现象，或者说共同指向同一件事</div></div><div class="reply"><div class="reply-h"><span class="who">tideglass</span><span class="rank">声望 96</span><span class="floor">#7</span></div><div class="reply-b"><span class="gt">>嗯……这么看来我觉得不像网络异常和脑死亡事件互相影响，更像是同一个过程留下的两个现象，或者说共同指向同一件事</span>

  function toggleHelp(on) {
    if (help)
      help.classList.toggle("on", on);
  }
  if (help)
    help.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target === help)
        toggleHelp(!1);
    });
  let sysTimer = null;
  function showSysNote() {
    const n = byId("sysnote");
    if (!n)
      return;
    n.classList.add("on");
    if (sysTimer)
      clearTimeout(sysTimer);
    sysTimer = setTimeout(() => n.classList.remove("on"), 3600);
  }
  let focusPane = "main";
  function sideVisible() {
    const s = byId("readerSide");
    return !!s && s.style.display !== "none";
  }
  function setFocus(p) {
    if (p === "side" && !sideVisible())
      return;
    focusPane = p;
    const m = byId("readerMain"), s = byId("readerSide");
    if (m)
      m.classList.toggle("focus", p === "main");
    if (s)
      s.classList.toggle("focus", p === "side");

  function scrollEl() {
    if (isReader)

  }
  function handleScroll(e) {
    const m = scrollEl();
    if (!m)
      return !1;
    const vp = m.clientHeight, page = vp - 48;
    switch (e.key) {
      case " ":

        return !0;
      case "b":
        e.preventDefault();

        return !0;
      case "d":
        e.preventDefault();

        return !0;
      case "u":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= vp / 2;

        return !0;
      case "End":
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;

      default:
        break;
    }
    if (isReader) {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "j") {
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop += 44;
        return !0;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp" || e.key === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        m.scrollTop -= 44;

  let homeItems = [], homeSel = 0;
  function paintHome() {

    paintHome();
    homeItems[homeSel].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }
  function openHomeSel() {
    const el = homeItems[homeSel];
    if (!el)
      return;
    if (el.getAttribute("data-locked")) {

    }
    const href = el.getAttribute("data-href");

  }
  if (opts.mode === "list") {
    const rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#threadlist tr")), locks = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".base-f [data-locked]"));
    homeItems = rows.concat(locks);

      tr.addEventListener("click", () => {
        homeSel = i;

    locks.forEach((el) => {
      const i = homeItems.indexOf(el);
      el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {

        paintHome();
      });
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        paintHome();
        showSysNote();
      });
    });

    if (pw)

  }
  let prevId = null, nextId = null, backHref = "/", navQuery = "";
  if (isReader) {
    const m = byId("readerMain"), s = byId("readerSide");
    if (m)
      m.addEventListener("mousedown", () => setFocus("main"));
    if (s)
      s.addEventListener("mousedown", () => setFocus("side"));
    setFocus("main");
    let b = "";
    try {
      b = new URL(arcade.url).searchParams.get("b") || "";
    } catch {
      b = "";
    }
    const lists = opts.lists || {};
    if (!lists[b])
      b = opts.ownBoardSlug || "";
    const list = lists[b] || [], idx = opts.id == null ? -1 : list.indexOf(opts.id);
    prevId = idx > 0 ? list[idx - 1] : null;
    nextId = idx >= 0 && idx < list.length - 1 ? list[idx + 1] : null;
    backHref = b === "recent" || b === "" ? "/" : `/b/${b}`;
    navQuery = b ? `?b=${b}` : "";
    const setNav = (elId, pid) => {
      const a = byId(elId);
      if (!a)
        return;
      if (pid == null) {
        a.classList.add("off");
        a.removeAttribute("href");
      } else {
        a.classList.remove("off");
        a.setAttribute("href", `/t/${pid}${navQuery}`);
      }
    };
    setNav("rdPrev", prevId);
    setNav("rdNext", nextId);
    const back = byId("rdBack");
    if (back)
      back.setAttribute("href", backHref);
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (help && help.classList.contains("on")) {
      if (e.key === "?" || e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleHelp(!1);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "?") {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleHelp(!0);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      if (isReader) {
        e.preventDefault();
        arcade.navigate(backHref);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (isReader && (e.key === "Tab" || e.key === "h" || e.key === "l")) {

        return;
      }

        e.preventDefault();
        moveHome(-1);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "ArrowRight") {
        e.preventDefault();

        return;

    }
  });

<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>#1832 最近有空，开个长期接单帖｜driftnet</title>

<style>/* ============================================================
   driftnet — a Tor onion forum, rendered inside the in-game
   Browser app. A WEBPAGE, not a terminal program. Board = a
   FILTER over a shared thread base; a visitor sees only a few
   recent readable threads per board, the rest is a locked
   paywall. Static multi-page render — each thread its own URL.
   RED = hot/live/active. BLUE = system/info/navigational.
   CGA palette only in masthead + chat nick colors.
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --bg:#0a0a0b; --bg-1:#0c0c0e; --bg-2:#101013; --bg-3:#15151a; --edge:#000005;
  --bone:#cdc8b8; --bone-hi:#efe9d8; --muted:#82796a; --dim:#4f4840; --faint:#2c2a28;
  --line:#1c1c20; --line-2:#141417;
  --red:#c0392b; --red-hi:#d8503f; --red-dim:#7c2a22; --red-ink:#170707;
  --blue:#5b86d8; --blue-hi:#7ba0e8; --blue-dim:#2c3f6b; --blue-ink:#0a1020;
  --cyan:#4fb6b6; --amber:#c8a24b; --green:#6f9f5a; --white:#efe9d8;
  --row:20px;
}
*{ box-sizing:border-box; }
html,body{ margin:0; padding:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--bone); height:100%; }
body{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono','Noto Sans SC',ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:13.5px; line-height:var(--row); font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility; font-variant-ligatures:none;
}
body::after{
  content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:90;
  background:radial-gradient(132% 112% at 50% 28%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 64%, rgba(0,0,0,.40) 100%);
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;
}
.acc{ color:var(--red); } .bone{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.muted{ color:var(--muted); } .dim{ color:var(--dim); }
.cyan{ color:var(--cyan); } .amber{ color:var(--amber); }
.green{ color:var(--green); } .num{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
a{ color:var(--blue); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; }
a:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); border-bottom-color:var(--blue-dim); }

.page{ height:100vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  background:radial-gradient(120% 56% at 50% -8%, rgba(54,52,58,.045), rgba(0,0,0,0) 56%), var(--bg);
  overflow:hidden; }
.main{ flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden; }
.col{ width:1040px; max-width:100%; margin:0 auto; padding:14px 18px 22px; }
pre.art{ margin:0; font:inherit; line-height:var(--row); white-space:pre; }

.panel{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-1); overflow:hidden; }
.panel + .panel{ margin-top:13px; }
.ph-bar{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--dim);
  background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.ph-bar .ttl{ color:var(--muted); }
.ph-bar .ttl .bd{ color:var(--blue); }
.ph-bar .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }

.masthead{ margin-top:2px; padding-bottom:2px; }

/* ===================== BOARD MENU (filter) ============== */
.menu{ margin-top:13px; }
.lightbar{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; padding:5px 7px; gap:2px; }
.lb{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:0 10px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row);
  font-size:12.5px; color:var(--bone); cursor:pointer; border:1px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap;
}
.lb .hot{ color:var(--red); }
.lb .cnt{ color:var(--dim); font-size:11px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.lb:hover{ background:var(--bg-3); }
.lb.sel{ background:var(--red); color:var(--red-ink); }
.lb.sel .hot{ color:var(--red-ink); } .lb.sel .cnt{ color:#3a1410; }
.lb, .lb:hover{ border-bottom-color:transparent; }

/* ===================== THREAD LIST ===================== */
.base{ margin-top:13px; }
table.threads{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px; table-layout:fixed; }
table.threads thead td{
  color:var(--dim); font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.04em; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row);
  padding:0 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-2);
}
table.threads tbody td{
  padding:0 12px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);
  vertical-align:middle; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
table.threads tbody tr:last-child td{ border-bottom:0; }
table.threads tbody tr{ cursor:pointer; }
table.threads tbody tr:hover td, table.threads tbody tr.sel td{ background:var(--bg-3); }
table.threads tbody tr.sel td{ box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--red); }
table.threads tbody tr.sel .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }

.c-no{ width:52px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.c-bd{ width:74px; }
.c-title{ color:var(--bone); }
.c-meta{ width:104px; color:var(--muted); text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.c-by{ width:84px; color:var(--muted); text-align:right; }
.c-act{ width:78px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; }

.bd{ color:var(--blue); }
.tag{ color:var(--dim); }
.tag.pin{ color:var(--red); } .tag.hot{ color:var(--red); }

tr.live .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.liveflag{ color:var(--red); font-size:11px; margin-left:9px; border:1px solid var(--red-dim); border-radius:2px; padding:0 5px; }
.liveflag .d{ color:var(--red); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){ .liveflag .d{ animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } }
@keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.32} }

/* guest notice — BLUE system voice */
.guestnote{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px;
  background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue);
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;
}
.guestnote .sig{ color:var(--blue); flex:0 0 auto; }
.guestnote .t{ color:var(--muted); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }

/* ---- PAYWALL: redacted unreadable threads, can't even read titles ---- */
.paywall{ position:relative; border-top:1px solid var(--line-2); cursor:not-allowed; user-select:none; overflow:hidden; }
.pw-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 12px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); }
.pw-row .pw-no{ width:52px; }
.pw-bar{ color:var(--faint); letter-spacing:-1px; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; filter:blur(1.1px); }
.pw-bar.t{ flex:1; }
.pw-bar.s{ width:120px; text-align:right; flex:0 0 auto; }
.pw-row.r1{ opacity:.62 } .pw-row.r2{ opacity:.40 } .pw-row.r3{ opacity:.24 } .pw-row.r4{ opacity:.12 }
.pw-veil{
  position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; padding-bottom:9px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12,12,14,0) 0%, rgba(12,12,14,.55) 52%, var(--bg-1) 92%);
}
.pw-veil .lock{ color:var(--blue); font-size:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; }
.pw-veil .lock .pad{ font-size:11px; }
.pw-veil .lock .sub{ color:var(--dim); }

.base-f{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11px; color:var(--dim);
  background:var(--bg-2); border-top:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;
}
.base-f .pg{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.base-f .pg .lbl{ padding-right:4px; }
.base-f .pg span{ padding:0 5px; }
.base-f .pg .on{ background:var(--red); color:var(--red-ink); }
.base-f .pg .lock{ color:var(--faint); cursor:not-allowed; }
.base-f .pg .lock:hover{ color:var(--dim); }
.base-f .pg .lock .pad{ font-size:10px; padding-right:2px; }
.base-f .older{ color:var(--faint); cursor:not-allowed; }
.base-f .older:hover{ color:var(--dim); }
.base-f .older .pad{ font-size:10px; padding-right:3px; }
.base-f .lock.sel, .base-f .older.sel{ color:var(--blue); box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue-dim); }
.base-f .lock.sel .pad, .base-f .older.sel .pad{ color:var(--blue); }
.base-f .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }

/* in-lore SYSTEM notice */
.sysnote{
  position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:64px; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); z-index:115;
  max-width:min(560px,92vw); background:var(--bg-1); border:1px solid var(--blue-dim);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--edge), 0 18px 50px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.92);
  color:var(--blue); font-size:12.5px; line-height:19px; padding:9px 14px 10px;
  opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .14s ease-out, transform .14s ease-out;
}

        paintHome();
      });
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        homeSel = i;
        paintHome();
        showSysNote();
      });
    });
    const pw = byId("paywall");
    if (pw)
      pw.addEventListener("click", showSysNote);
    paintHome();
  }
  let prevId = null, nextId = null, backHref = "/", navQuery = "";
  if (isReader) {
    const m = byId("readerMain"), s = byId("readerSide");
    if (m)
      m.addEventListener("mousedown", () => setFocus("main"));
    if (s)
      s.addEventListener("mousedown", () => setFocus("side"));
    setFocus("main");
    let b = "";
    try {
      b = new URL(arcade.url).searchParams.get("b") || "";
    } catch {
      b = "";
    }
    const lists = opts.lists || {};
    if (!lists[b])
      b = opts.ownBoardSlug || "";
    const list = lists[b] || [], idx = opts.id == null ? -1 : list.indexOf(opts.id);
    prevId = idx > 0 ? list[idx - 1] : null;
    nextId = idx >= 0 && idx < list.length - 1 ? list[idx + 1] : null;
    backHref = b === "recent" || b === "" ? "/" : `/b/${b}`;
    navQuery = b ? `?b=${b}` : "";
    const setNav = (elId, pid) => {
      const a = byId(elId);
      if (!a)
        return;
      if (pid == null) {
        a.classList.add("off");
        a.removeAttribute("href");
      } else {
        a.classList.remove("off");
        a.setAttribute("href", `/t/${pid}${navQuery}`);
      }
    };
    setNav("rdPrev", prevId);
    setNav("rdNext", nextId);
    const back = byId("rdBack");
    if (back)
      back.setAttribute("href", backHref);
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (help && help.classList.contains("on")) {
      if (e.key === "?" || e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleHelp(!1);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "?") {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleHelp(!0);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      if (isReader) {
        e.preventDefault();
        arcade.navigate(backHref);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (isReader && (e.key === "Tab" || e.key === "h" || e.key === "l")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (e.key === "h")
        setFocus("main");
      else if (e.key === "l") {
        if (sideVisible())

      } else

    if (handleScroll(e))
      return;

      const k = e.key.toLowerCase();

        e.preventDefault();

        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp" || k === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        moveHome(-1);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "ArrowRight") {
        e.preventDefault();
        openHomeSel();
        return;
      }
      const dig = opts.digits[e.key];
      if (dig) {
        e.preventDefault();
        arcade.navigate(dig);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "[" || e.key.toLowerCase() === "p") {

        arcade.navigate(`/t/${prevId}${navQuery}`);
      return;
    }

<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>#1834 [持续更新] 各家公司旧漏洞帖汇总（持续更新）｜driftnet</title>

<style>/* ============================================================
   driftnet — a Tor onion forum, rendered inside the in-game
   Browser app. A WEBPAGE, not a terminal program. Board = a
   FILTER over a shared thread base; a visitor sees only a few
   recent readable threads per board, the rest is a locked
   paywall. Static multi-page render — each thread its own URL.
   RED = hot/live/active. BLUE = system/info/navigational.
   CGA palette only in masthead + chat nick colors.
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --bg:#0a0a0b; --bg-1:#0c0c0e; --bg-2:#101013; --bg-3:#15151a; --edge:#000005;
  --bone:#cdc8b8; --bone-hi:#efe9d8; --muted:#82796a; --dim:#4f4840; --faint:#2c2a28;
  --line:#1c1c20; --line-2:#141417;
  --red:#c0392b; --red-hi:#d8503f; --red-dim:#7c2a22; --red-ink:#170707;
  --blue:#5b86d8; --blue-hi:#7ba0e8; --blue-dim:#2c3f6b; --blue-ink:#0a1020;
  --cyan:#4fb6b6; --amber:#c8a24b; --green:#6f9f5a; --white:#efe9d8;
  --row:20px;
}
*{ box-sizing:border-box; }
html,body{ margin:0; padding:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--bone); height:100%; }
body{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono','Noto Sans SC',ui-monospace,'Cascadia Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  font-size:13.5px; line-height:var(--row); font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility; font-variant-ligatures:none;
}
body::after{
  content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:90;
  background:radial-gradient(132% 112% at 50% 28%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 64%, rgba(0,0,0,.40) 100%);
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;
}
.acc{ color:var(--red); } .bone{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.muted{ color:var(--muted); } .dim{ color:var(--dim); }
.cyan{ color:var(--cyan); } .amber{ color:var(--amber); }
.green{ color:var(--green); } .num{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
a{ color:var(--blue); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; }
a:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); border-bottom-color:var(--blue-dim); }

.page{ height:100vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  background:radial-gradient(120% 56% at 50% -8%, rgba(54,52,58,.045), rgba(0,0,0,0) 56%), var(--bg);
  overflow:hidden; }
.main{ flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden; }
.col{ width:1040px; max-width:100%; margin:0 auto; padding:14px 18px 22px; }
pre.art{ margin:0; font:inherit; line-height:var(--row); white-space:pre; }

.panel{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-1); overflow:hidden; }
.panel + .panel{ margin-top:13px; }
.ph-bar{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--dim);
  background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.ph-bar .ttl{ color:var(--muted); }
.ph-bar .ttl .bd{ color:var(--blue); }
.ph-bar .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }

.masthead{ margin-top:2px; padding-bottom:2px; }

/* ===================== BOARD MENU (filter) ============== */
.menu{ margin-top:13px; }
.lightbar{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; padding:5px 7px; gap:2px; }
.lb{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:0 10px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row);
  font-size:12.5px; color:var(--bone); cursor:pointer; border:1px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap;
}
.lb .hot{ color:var(--red); }
.lb .cnt{ color:var(--dim); font-size:11px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.lb:hover{ background:var(--bg-3); }
.lb.sel{ background:var(--red); color:var(--red-ink); }
.lb.sel .hot{ color:var(--red-ink); } .lb.sel .cnt{ color:#3a1410; }
.lb, .lb:hover{ border-bottom-color:transparent; }

/* ===================== THREAD LIST ===================== */
.base{ margin-top:13px; }
table.threads{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px; table-layout:fixed; }
table.threads thead td{
  color:var(--dim); font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.04em; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row);
  padding:0 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg-2);
}
table.threads tbody td{
  padding:0 12px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);
  vertical-align:middle; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
table.threads tbody tr:last-child td{ border-bottom:0; }
table.threads tbody tr{ cursor:pointer; }
table.threads tbody tr:hover td, table.threads tbody tr.sel td{ background:var(--bg-3); }
table.threads tbody tr.sel td{ box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--red); }
table.threads tbody tr.sel .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }

.c-no{ width:52px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.c-bd{ width:74px; }
.c-title{ color:var(--bone); }
.c-meta{ width:104px; color:var(--muted); text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.c-by{ width:84px; color:var(--muted); text-align:right; }
.c-act{ width:78px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; font-size:11.5px; }

.bd{ color:var(--blue); }
.tag{ color:var(--dim); }
.tag.pin{ color:var(--red); } .tag.hot{ color:var(--red); }

tr.live .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.liveflag{ color:var(--red); font-size:11px; margin-left:9px; border:1px solid var(--red-dim); border-radius:2px; padding:0 5px; }
.liveflag .d{ color:var(--red); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){ .liveflag .d{ animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } }
@keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.32} }

/* guest notice — BLUE system voice */
.guestnote{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px;
  background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue);
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;
}
.guestnote .sig{ color:var(--blue); flex:0 0 auto; }
.guestnote .t{ color:var(--muted); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }

/* ---- PAYWALL: redacted unreadable threads, can't even read titles ---- */
.paywall{ position:relative; border-top:1px solid var(--line-2); cursor:not-allowed; user-select:none; overflow:hidden; }
.pw-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 12px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); }
.pw-row .pw-no{ width:52px; }
.pw-bar{ color:var(--faint); letter-spacing:-1px; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; filter:blur(1.1px); }
.pw-bar.t{ flex:1; }
.pw-bar.s{ width:120px; text-align:right; flex:0 0 auto; }
.pw-row.r1{ opacity:.62 } .pw-row.r2{ opacity:.40 } .pw-row.r3{ opacity:.24 } .pw-row.r4{ opacity:.12 }
.pw-veil{
  position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; padding-bottom:9px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12,12,14,0) 0%, rgba(12,12,14,.55) 52%, var(--bg-1) 92%);
}
.pw-veil .lock{ color:var(--blue); font-size:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; }
.pw-veil .lock .pad{ font-size:11px; }
.pw-veil .lock .sub{ color:var(--dim); }

.base-f{
  height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11px; color:var(--dim);
  background:var(--bg-2); border-top:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;
}
.base-f .pg{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.base-f .pg .lbl{ padding-right:4px; }
.base-f .pg span{ padding:0 5px; }
.base-f .pg .on{ background:var(--red); color:var(--red-ink); }
.base-f .pg .lock{ color:var(--faint); cursor:not-allowed; }
.base-f .pg .lock:hover{ color:var(--dim); }
.base-f .pg .lock .pad{ font-size:10px; padding-right:2px; }
.base-f .older{ color:var(--faint); cursor:not-allowed; }
.base-f .older:hover{ color:var(--dim); }
.base-f .older .pad{ font-size:10px; padding-right:3px; }
.base-f .lock.sel, .base-f .older.sel{ color:var(--blue); box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--blue-dim); }
.base-f .lock.sel .pad, .base-f .older.sel .pad{ color:var(--blue); }
.base-f .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }

/* in-lore SYSTEM notice */
.sysnote{
  position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:64px; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); z-index:115;
  max-width:min(560px,92vw); background:var(--bg-1); border:1px solid var(--blue-dim);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--edge), 0 18px 50px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.92);
  color:var(--blue); font-size:12.5px; line-height:19px; padding:9px 14px 10px;
  opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .14s ease-out, transform .14s ease-out;
}
.sysnote.on{ opacity:1; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
.sysnote .sig{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.sysnote .body{ color:var(--bone); display:block; margin-top:2px; }

/* ===================== READER ========================== */
.crumb{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 2px; margin-top:6px; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; }
.crumb a.back{ color:var(--blue); border:0; cursor:pointer; }
.crumb a.back:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.crumb .here{ color:var(--dim); }

.msg{ margin-top:8px; }
.msg-head{ padding:7px 14px 8px; font-size:12px; background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; gap:1px 14px; }
.msg-head .k{ color:var(--dim); }
.msg-head .v{ color:var(--bone); }
.msg-head .v .sp{ display:inline-block; width:12px; }
.msg-head .v.subj{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.msg-head .v .tag{ color:var(--red); } .msg-head .v .op{ color:var(--red); } .msg-head .v .on{ color:var(--red); }
.msg-head .v .bd{ color:var(--blue); } .msg-head .v .rank{ color:var(--dim); }
.msg-body{ padding:13px 16px 16px; font-size:13.5px; line-height:22px; color:var(--bone); white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; max-width:76ch; background:var(--bg-1); }
.gt{ color:var(--green); }                 /* greentext */
.qref{ color:var(--blue); }                /* >> quote ref */
.msg-foot{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11px; color:var(--dim); background:var(--bg-2); border-top:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; }
.msg-foot .k{ color:var(--muted); } .msg-foot .v{ color:var(--bone); } .msg-foot .on{ color:var(--red); }
.msg-foot .nav{ margin-left:auto; display:flex; gap:16px; }
.msg-foot .nav a{ color:var(--blue); border:0; cursor:pointer; }
.msg-foot .nav a:hover{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.msg-foot .nav a.off{ color:var(--faint); cursor:default; }

/* ---- replies ---- */
.replies{ margin-top:13px; }
.replies .rh{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 12px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--dim); background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); }
.replies .rh b{ color:var(--muted); font-weight:400; }
.reply{ padding:6px 14px 9px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); }
.reply:last-child{ border-bottom:0; }
.reply-h{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--dim); display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:9px; }
.reply-h .who{ color:var(--bone); }
.reply-h .who.anon{ color:var(--muted); }
.reply-h .rank{ color:var(--dim); }
.reply-h .floor{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.reply-b{ margin-top:2px; font-size:13px; line-height:21px; color:var(--bone); white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; max-width:76ch; }
.replies-closed{ padding:8px 14px 10px; font-size:12px; color:var(--dim); }
.reply-h .who.df{ color:var(--blue); }

/* ---- bounty install affordance (sits under the OP body) ---- */
.bounty-act{ margin:11px 16px 2px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid var(--red-dim); background:var(--bg-2); font-size:12.5px; line-height:19px; }
.bounty-act .lbl{ color:var(--dim); }
.bounty-act .install{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; color:var(--red); cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--red-dim); padding:0 11px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); background:var(--red-ink); }
.bounty-act .install:hover{ color:var(--red-hi); border-color:var(--red); background:#220a06; }
.bounty-act .install.busy{ color:var(--dim); border-color:var(--line); background:var(--bg-3); cursor:default; }
.bounty-act .install .b{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.bounty-act.done{ border-color:var(--blue-dim); }
.bounty-act .ok{ color:var(--blue); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
.bounty-act .ok .sig{ color:var(--blue-hi); }
.bounty-act .ok .where{ color:var(--muted); }

/* ===================== irssi IRC CLIENT =============== */
.irc{ margin-top:13px; background:var(--bg-1); }
.irc-top{ height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); padding:0 10px; font-size:12px; background:var(--bg-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge); color:var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; }
.irc-top .br{ color:var(--dim); } .irc-top .chan{ color:var(--bone); }
.irc-top .topic{ color:var(--muted); padding-left:9px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.irc-grid{ display:flex; min-height:360px; }
.irc-buf{ flex:0 0 152px; border-right:1px solid var(--line-2); background:var(--bg-1); padding:4px 0; font-size:12px; }
.buf-h{ color:var(--dim); font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.04em; padding:0 11px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); }
.buf{ padding:0 11px; height:var(--row); line-height:var(--row); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:var(--muted); cursor:default; }
.buf .n{ color:var(--dim); width:11px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.buf.on{ background:var(--bg-3); color:var(--bone); box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--red); }
.buf.on .n{ color:var(--red); } .buf .act{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--red); font-size:10px; }
.irc-mid{ flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.irc-log{ padding:7px 12px 9px; font-size:12.5px; line-height:20px; }
.irc-top .arch{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--dim); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:2px; padding:0 6px; font-size:11px; }
/* thread reader = two columns for channel threads: post+comments | transcript */
.reader-cols{ display:flex; gap:13px; align-items:flex-start; margin-top:8px; }
/* each column is viewport-bounded and scrolls on its own (tmux/lazygit panes) */
.reader-main{ flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; max-height:calc(100vh - 96px); overflow-y:auto; outline:1px solid transparent; outline-offset:-1px; }
.reader-side{ flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; }
.reader-side .chanlog{ margin-top:0; outline:1px solid transparent; outline-offset:-1px; }
.reader-side .irc-log{ max-height:calc(100vh - 174px); overflow-y:auto; }
/* focused pane gets an accent outline */
.reader-main.focus{ outline-color:var(--red-dim); }
.reader-side.focus .chanlog{ outline-color:var(--red-dim); }
/* first panel sits flush inside the pane (no gap under the focus outline) */
.reader-main .msg{ margin-top:0; }
/* archived channel panel (single column, lives in the right reader column) */
.irc-top .topic{ flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0; }
.chan-meta{ padding:3px 12px; min-height:var(--row); line-height:19px; font-size:11.5px; background:var(--bg-1); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:2px 9px; }
.chan-meta .k{ color:var(--dim); }
.chan-meta .cp.op{ font-weight:500; }
.irc-foot{ padding:3px 12px; min-height:var(--row); line-height:18px; font-size:11px; color:var(--dim); background:var(--bg-2); border-top:1px solid var(--edge); display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:2px 16px; }
.irc-foot .k{ color:var(--muted); }
.irc-foot .right{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--faint); }
.chanflag{ color:var(--blue); font-size:11px; margin-left:9px; border:1px solid var(--blue-dim); border-radius:2px; padding:0 5px; }
tr.chan .c-title{ color:var(--bone-hi); }
.ln{ display:flex; white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){ .ln{ animation:appear .16s ease-out both; } }
@keyframes appear{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(2px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none} }
.ln .t{ color:var(--dim); flex:0 0 auto; width:44px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
