.section-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.section-row-num { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 400; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1; }
.section-row-title { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; margin: 0 0 8px; }
a:hover .section-row-title { color: var(--sub); }
.section-row-ex { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--sub); margin: 0 0 10px; }
.section-row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.section-row-art .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }

.section-empty { padding: 56px 0 64px; text-align: center; }
.section-empty .empty-stamp {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 26px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  padding-left: 0.2em;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
  padding-top: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 250px;
}
.section-empty .empty-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 0 auto 18px;
  max-width: 32em;
}
.section-empty .empty-meta { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--meta); margin: 0; }
.section-empty .empty-meta a { color: var(--sub); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.section-empty .empty-meta a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— static pages (about / contact / sponsor) —— */
.static-section { margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.static-section h2 {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding-left: 0.45em;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}
.static-section p {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.static-section p.small { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); text-align: left; }
.static-page .article-body p.lede { text-align: justify; }
.masthead-dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
  gap: 8px 20px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}
.masthead-dl dt { color: var(--meta); text-align: right; }
.masthead-dl dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); }

.sponsor-banner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.sponsor-banner .sponsor-tag {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 0 8px;
}
.sponsor-cta-line {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
  padding: 14px 0 !important;
  margin: 18px 0 !important;
}
.sponsor-fine {
  font-family: var(--sans) !important;
  color: var(--meta) !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  line-height: 1.7 !important;
  text-align: left !important;
}

/* —— small screens (the in-game browser can be narrow) —— */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .page { padding: 0 16px; }
  .mast { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .ear { display: none; }
  .cover { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cover-main { padding-right: 0; border-right: 0; }
  .cover-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cover-rail { padding-left: 0; margin-top: 22px; }
  .feat { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; row-gap: 20px; }
  .feat article { padding: 0 14px 0 0; border-right: 0; }
  .lower { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .lower-main { border-right: 0; padding-right: 0; }
  .lower-rail { padding-left: 0; }
  .series-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .series-cols article { padding: 10px 0; border-right: 0; }
  .row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .row .thumb { max-width: 220px; }
  .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .related-card { padding: 12px 0; border-right: 0; }
  .section-row { grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .section-row-art { display: none; }
  .comment-time { margin-left: 0; }
}
</style>
</head>

data.title: 弗图姆科技公开 AlephPro 理论研究与数据观测：现实的一切都有信息投影｜子午线邮报

<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>弗图姆科技公开 AlephPro 理论研究与数据观测：现实的一切都有信息投影｜子午线邮报</title>

<style>/*
 * The Meridian Post — 合刊 (broadsheet editorial)
 *
 * A flat printed sheet: blackletter English masthead over spaced 子午线邮报,
 * masthead ears, a double-rule dateline bar, centered multi-deck cover story,
 * hairline column packages, centered letterspaced section headers, boxed
 * series feature and a page index. Graphite hierarchy on warm paper; colour
 * photographs lightly desaturated; the only red is the rubber-stamp cinnabar
 * on notices. No drop shadows, no textures, no tracked-uppercase labels, no
 * monospace ornament.
 */

:root {
  --ink: #141312;
  --sub: #55524c;
  --meta: #797469;
  --rule: #ddd8cd;
  --dark: #141312;
  --paper: #fdfcf9;
  --paper-2: #f4f1ea;
  --backdrop: #f2f0ea;
  --stamp: #a8362a;
  --up: #2f6b34;
  --down: #a8362a;

  --serif: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', 'SimSun', serif;
  --sans: 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --blackletter: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--backdrop);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: 'kern' 1, 'tnum' 1;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
i, em, cite { font-style: normal; }
img { display: block; }

.page {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 34px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* —— masthead: ears + blackletter + dateline bar —— */
.mast {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 26px 0 18px;
}
.ear {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 7px 11px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 185px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.ear.right { justify-self: end; text-align: right; }
.mast-c { text-align: center; display: block; }
.mast-c .english {
  font-family: var(--blackletter);
  font-size: 54px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.mast-c .chinese {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
  letter-spacing: 0.85em;
  padding-left: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.dateline {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.dateline::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dateline .in {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  padding: 6px 2px;
}

/* —— nav —— */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark); }
.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.nav a { padding: 8px 13px; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a.is-active { background: var(--dark); color: var(--paper); }

/* —— back rail (inner pages) —— */
.back-rail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.back-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— post-game 快讯 strip (index.end variant) —— */
.breaking {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 11px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.breaking-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  flex: none;
}
.breaking a { min-width: 0; }
.breaking-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.breaking a:hover .breaking-title { color: var(--sub); }
.breaking-time { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

/* —— new-edition sash (act2 front page, until dismissed) ——
   A cinnabar wrap band across the cover, full-bleed against the page borders.
   The one big solid block in a sheet of hairlines. 知道了 folds the band up
   and emits the seen fact. */
.sash-slot {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 -34px;
  max-height: 130px;
  transition: max-height .45s ease;
}
.sash-slot[hidden] { display: none; }
.sash-slot.folded { max-height: 0; }
.sash {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 16px 30px 20px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(253, 252, 249, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(100deg, #9c3226 0%, var(--stamp) 45%, #b23e30 100%);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 19, 18, 0.25);
  transform-origin: 12% 100%;
  animation: sash-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes sash-in {
  from { transform: translateX(-30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
}
.sash::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -7px;
  height: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0);
  background-size: 14px 8px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}
.sash-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: .25em;
  border: 2px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.85);
  padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px;
}
.sash-text {
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sash-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12.5px var(--sans);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.7);
  padding: 5px 16px;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.sash-close:hover { background: #fdf7ee; color: var(--stamp); }

/* —— cover package —— */
.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  padding: 26px 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.cover-main { padding-right: 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.deck-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.deck-hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-top: 10px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.deck-hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.deck-sub {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 42em;
}
.deck-by { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 336px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: start;
}
.cover-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.cover-body p { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cover-body p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 2.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 3px 7px 0 0;
}
.cont {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: right;
}
a.cont:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.cover-fig .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.cover-fig .caption { text-align: right; }

/* —— cover rail —— */
.cover-rail { padding-left: 24px; }
.rail-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding: 7px 0 7px 0.45em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.brief { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.brief li { padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.brief li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.brief .lbl {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}
.brief .txt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }
.mr { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.mr li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.mr li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.mr .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 20px; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1.1; }
.mr .t { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
.mr .t a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.mkt table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.mkt td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.mkt tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.mkt .d { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.mkt .up { color: var(--up); }
.mkt .down { color: var(--down); }

/* —— featured row —— */
.feat {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  column-gap: 41px;
  padding: 22px 0;
}
.feat article { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.feat article:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.feat .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.feat .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: 13px;
}
.feat .hed a:hover, .feat a:hover .hed { color: var(--sub); }
.feat .center-rule { width: 34px; height: 1px; background: var(--ink); margin: 9px auto; }
.feat .txt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;

loading="eager"/></div><figcaption class="caption"><span>弗图姆科技 AlephPro 实验区入口。</span></figcaption></figure></div><div class="article-body"><div><p>弗图姆科技昨日发布 AlephPro 最新理论研究与数据观测报告。报告用一句话概括了核心结论，这句话随后登上了多个平台的热搜：「我们的宇宙不唯一。」</p></div><div><p>报告称，公司的持续观测表明，AlephPro 是一个由信息流构成的独立维度，而我们世界中的一切事物，都以信息的形式完整投影其中。「信息不是对事物的描述。信息是事物本身的一种存在形态。」发言人在发布会上解释道，「举个例子，一颗星星有位置、运动状态、组成物质、内部温度等信息。把这些信息全部叠加起来，就是那颗星星。你，我，此刻这间发布厅，也一样。我们每个人，都在 AlephPro 里以同等的完整度存在着。此时此刻。一直如此。」</p></div><div><p>「宇宙从诞生的那一刻起就在做这件事。」发言人继续说，「只是直到信息大爆炸的数字时代，人类的技术才终于够到了这个维度的门槛。换句话说，我们没有发明 AlephPro，而是我们发现了它。它等了我们一百三十八亿年。」</p><blockquote class="pull-quote">「信息是事物本身的一种存在形态。」</blockquote></div><div><p>发言人称，这一发现的意义「需要用世纪为单位来衡量」，并援引报告原文，「哥白尼告诉人类，我们不在宇宙的中心；而 AlephPro 告诉人类，我们所在的这个宇宙，也许只是更加庞大的存在的冰山一角。」公司表示，未来数年将把 AlephPro 的研究与开发利用作为最高战略重点。报告同时宣布，公司已设立由独立学者组成的 AlephPro 伦理审查委员会。</p></div></div></main></article><section class="related-strip"><h2>同版文章</h2><div class="related-grid"><a class="related-card" href="/article/vertumn-aleph-launch"><div class="related-thumb"><figure class="photo"><div class="photo-frame photo-3x2"><img src="/webAssets/meridian_post/pexels-34774346.jpg" alt="弗图姆科技产业技术日，演讲者站在巨幅屏幕前。" loading="lazy"/></div></figure></div><div class="lbl">弗图姆科技 AlephPro</div><h3 class="ttl">「万物皆可计算」：直击弗图姆科技 AlephPro 发布会</h3><p class="ex">弗图姆科技在今日发布会上宣布，AlephPro 将带来算力格局的「终局性颠覆」。公司宣称，AlephPro 可同时处理近乎无穷量级的信息，使算力彻底摆脱物理设施的限制，并承诺推动算力普惠。</p></a><a class="related-card" href="/article/home-compute-craze"><div class="related-thumb"><figure class="photo"><div class="photo-frame photo-3x2"><img src="/webAssets/meridian_post/pexels-34728839.jpg" alt="客厅柜子上并排立着两块显卡，旁边是拆开的机箱和一件陶瓷摆件。" loading="lazy"/></div></figure></div><div class="lbl">算力经济</div><h3 class="ttl">一柜显卡一份租金：家庭算力出租正在成为全民副业</h3><p class="ex">把显卡装满机柜、把算力挂上网出租，正在从极客爱好变成普通家庭的副业。签公会、攒共鸣、重新训练……这套行话背后已经长出一个自成一体的小经济。</p></a><a class="related-card" href="/article/aleph-series-3"><div class="related-thumb"><figure class="photo"><div class="photo-frame photo-3x2"><img src="/webAssets/meridian_post/pexels-28437443.jpg" alt="清晨海面上的货轮 —— 系列报道使用的航行意象。" loading="lazy"/></div></figure></div><div class="lbl">系列之三</div><h3 class="ttl">弗图姆闭门会议实录：AlephPro 的真正野心是平行世界</h3><p class="ex">弗图姆科技 CEO 在面向核心投资方的闭门会议中披露，AlephPro 所容纳的信息不止于本宇宙曾发生过的事，还以同等的真实程度记载了「所有逻辑上可能存在的世界」，并称这或将意味着「人类史上第一次对平行世界的抵达」。</p></a></div></section><footer class="foot"><p>© The Meridian Post 子午线邮报　总编 伊夫琳·阿什　科技板块主编 马库斯·哈雷维</p><p>编辑部 蓝湾市 子午线大街 1884 号　<a data.title: 所有科学发现已经完成：弗图姆科技称 AlephPro 将终结传统科研｜子午线邮报
data.body_html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>所有科学发现已经完成：弗图姆科技称 AlephPro 将终结传统科研｜子午线邮报</title>

<style>/*
 * The Meridian Post — 合刊 (broadsheet editorial)
 *
 * A flat printed sheet: blackletter English masthead over spaced 子午线邮报,
 * masthead ears, a double-rule dateline bar, centered multi-deck cover story,
 * hairline column packages, centered letterspaced section headers, boxed
 * series feature and a page index. Graphite hierarchy on warm paper; colour
 * photographs lightly desaturated; the only red is the rubber-stamp cinnabar
 * on notices. No drop shadows, no textures, no tracked-uppercase labels, no
 * monospace ornament.
 */

:root {
  --ink: #141312;
  --sub: #55524c;
  --meta: #797469;
  --rule: #ddd8cd;
  --dark: #141312;
  --paper: #fdfcf9;
  --paper-2: #f4f1ea;
  --backdrop: #f2f0ea;
  --stamp: #a8362a;
  --up: #2f6b34;
  --down: #a8362a;

  --serif: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', 'SimSun', serif;
  --sans: 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --blackletter: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--backdrop);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: 'kern' 1, 'tnum' 1;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
i, em, cite { font-style: normal; }
img { display: block; }

.page {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 34px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* —— masthead: ears + blackletter + dateline bar —— */
.mast {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 26px 0 18px;
}
.ear {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 7px 11px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 185px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.ear.right { justify-self: end; text-align: right; }
.mast-c { text-align: center; display: block; }
.mast-c .english {
  font-family: var(--blackletter);
  font-size: 54px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.mast-c .chinese {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
  letter-spacing: 0.85em;
  padding-left: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.dateline {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.dateline::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dateline .in {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  padding: 6px 2px;
}

/* —— nav —— */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark); }
.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.nav a { padding: 8px 13px; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a.is-active { background: var(--dark); color: var(--paper); }

/* —— back rail (inner pages) —— */
.back-rail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.back-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— post-game 快讯 strip (index.end variant) —— */
.breaking {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 11px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.breaking-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  flex: none;
}
.breaking a { min-width: 0; }
.breaking-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.breaking a:hover .breaking-title { color: var(--sub); }
.breaking-time { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

/* —— new-edition sash (act2 front page, until dismissed) ——
   A cinnabar wrap band across the cover, full-bleed against the page borders.
   The one big solid block in a sheet of hairlines. 知道了 folds the band up
   and emits the seen fact. */
.sash-slot {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 -34px;
  max-height: 130px;
  transition: max-height .45s ease;
}
.sash-slot[hidden] { display: none; }
.sash-slot.folded { max-height: 0; }
.sash {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 16px 30px 20px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(253, 252, 249, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(100deg, #9c3226 0%, var(--stamp) 45%, #b23e30 100%);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 19, 18, 0.25);
  transform-origin: 12% 100%;
  animation: sash-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes sash-in {
  from { transform: translateX(-30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
}
.sash::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -7px;
  height: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0);
  background-size: 14px 8px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}
.sash-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: .25em;
  border: 2px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.85);
  padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px;
}
.sash-text {
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sash-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12.5px var(--sans);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.7);
  padding: 5px 16px;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.sash-close:hover { background: #fdf7ee; color: var(--stamp); }

/* —— cover package —— */
.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  padding: 26px 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.cover-main { padding-right: 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.deck-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.deck-hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-top: 10px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.deck-hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.deck-sub {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 42em;
}
.deck-by { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 336px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: start;
}
.cover-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.cover-body p { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cover-body p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 2.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 3px 7px 0 0;
}
.cont {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: right;
}
a.cont:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.cover-fig .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.cover-fig .caption { text-align: right; }

/* —— cover rail —— */
.cover-rail { padding-left: 24px; }
.rail-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding: 7px 0 7px 0.45em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.brief { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.brief li { padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.brief li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.brief .lbl {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}
.brief .txt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }
.mr { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.mr li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.mr li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.mr .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 20px; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1.1; }
.mr .t { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
.mr .t a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.mkt table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.mkt td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.mkt tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.mkt .d { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.mkt .up { color: var(--up); }
.mkt .down { color: var(--down); }

/* —— featured row —— */
.feat {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  column-gap: 41px;
  padding: 22px 0;
}
.feat article { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.feat article:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.feat .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.feat .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: 13px;
}
.feat .hed a:hover, .feat a:hover .hed { color: var(--sub); }
.feat .center-rule { width: 34px; height: 1px; background: var(--ink); margin: 9px auto; }
.feat .txt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.feat .src { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; }

/* —— lower split: section stacks + rail —— */
.lower {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
}
.lower-main { padding: 0 26px 8px 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.lower-rail { padding: 0 0 8px 24px; }

.sec { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.sec:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sec-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.55em;
  padding: 0 0 9px 0.55em;
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
}
.sec-h a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 150px;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.row.no-art { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.row-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
a:hover .row-title { color: var(--sub); }
.row-excerpt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.thumb { display: block; }
.thumb .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }

/* —— lower rail blocks —— */
.rail-blk { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.rail-blk:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.rail-blk .rail-h { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.wx table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.wx td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.wx tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.wx .c { color: var(--meta); }
.wx .t { text-align: right; }

/* boxed print ads (sponsored + Pulse) */
.ad-box { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 14px 14px 16px; }
.ad-box:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-tag {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.ad-box .photo-frame { margin-bottom: 11px; background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-hed {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 7px;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-cta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 9px;
  border-top: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.pulse-logo {
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.pulse-trends { list-style: none; margin-top: 10px; }
.pulse-trends li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.pulse-trends li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.pulse-trends .t-rank { color: var(--meta); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pulse-trends .t-count { color: var(--meta); font-size: 11px; }

/* —— series box —— */
.series-box { border: 3px double var(--dark); margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 18px 24px 22px; }
.series-box .h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

class="article-meta-block"><div class="article-kicker">系列之二</div><h1 class="article-headline">所有科学发现已经完成：弗图姆科技称 AlephPro 将终结传统科研</h1><p class="article-standfirst">弗图姆科技在产业前景说明会上表示，AlephPro 是信息自我推演、与现实因果对应的「海洋」，人类可跳过研究直接获取答案，癌症药物、核聚变参数、气候演变均已在其中演算完毕。发言人宣称，「人类未来所有的科学发现已经完成，它们只是在等我们取回来。」首个接入模型即将上线。</p><div class="article-byline"><span>记者 马库斯·哈雷维</span><span>蓝湾</span><span>8 月 21 日</span></div></div><div class="article-art"><figure class="photo"><div class="photo-frame photo-16x9"><img src="/webAssets/meridian_post/pexels-17489157.jpg" alt="弗图姆科技 AlephPro 算力实验区的服务器机柜。" loading="eager"/></div><figcaption class="caption"><span>弗图姆产业前景说明会现场。</span></figcaption></figure></div><div class="article-body"><div><p>弗图姆科技在昨日的产业前景说明会上纠正了外界的一个普遍误解：AlephPro 不是一座静态存储现实的图书馆。「它是一片暗流汹涌的海洋。」发言人表示，「信息在其中相互推动、自我推演，产生湍流。而这些活动与现实的因果严格对应。它就是答案本身。」</p></div><div><p>「这意味着什么？意味着人类可以跳过『研究』这个步骤了。」发言人在大屏幕上列出了一张清单，并逐条展开，「治愈癌症的药物。它的分子结构此刻就藏在 AlephPro 的某处，和其他所有可能的化合物在一起。我们不再需要十五年和二十亿美元去研发它。我们只需要找到它。可控核聚变的装置参数、常温超导的材料配比也是同理。」</p></div><div><p>「未来一百年的气候演变，不必再依赖超级计算机跑上几个月的模拟。这一切在 AlephPro 里已经精确演算完了，我们只要去调阅就可以。」</p></div><div><p>「每一次地震的时间和震级，每一场流行病的传播路径，每一种尚未被合成的材料、尚未被写出的算法、尚未被证明的定理。各位，请理解这句话的字面意思：人类未来所有的科学发现，已经全部完成了。它们只是在等我们取回来。」发言人称，这将使科研的范式发生根本迁移，「从研发走向识别，从预测走向观测，从发明走向打捞。」</p></div><div><p>据介绍，首个初步接入 AlephPro 的模型已基本完成研发，即将上线。AlephPro 应用领域的首批合作伙伴名单也将于六个月内公布。发言人在说明会的最后表示：「留给『传统科研』这个词的时间已经不多了。」</p></div><div><p>这一表态在学术界迅速激起反响。据悉，阿什福德大学、滨海科技大学等多所高校和研究机构已于当晚召开紧急会议，议题包括在读科研项目的中长期规划，以及下一学年是否继续按原计划招收博士研究生。一位与会教授在社交平台上写道，「我不知道该怎么面对明年入学的学生。」也有学者公开表示质疑，称弗图姆「至今未展示任何一项经同行评审的『打捞』成果」，呼吁学界保持清醒。</p></div></div></main></article><section <!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>弗图姆闭门会议实录：AlephPro 的真正野心是平行世界｜子午线邮报</title>

<style>/*
 * The Meridian Post — 合刊 (broadsheet editorial)
 *
 * A flat printed sheet: blackletter English masthead over spaced 子午线邮报,
 * masthead ears, a double-rule dateline bar, centered multi-deck cover story,
 * hairline column packages, centered letterspaced section headers, boxed
 * series feature and a page index. Graphite hierarchy on warm paper; colour
 * photographs lightly desaturated; the only red is the rubber-stamp cinnabar
 * on notices. No drop shadows, no textures, no tracked-uppercase labels, no
 * monospace ornament.
 */

:root {
  --ink: #141312;
  --sub: #55524c;
  --meta: #797469;
  --rule: #ddd8cd;
  --dark: #141312;
  --paper: #fdfcf9;
  --paper-2: #f4f1ea;
  --backdrop: #f2f0ea;
  --stamp: #a8362a;
  --up: #2f6b34;
  --down: #a8362a;

  --serif: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', 'SimSun', serif;
  --sans: 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --blackletter: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--backdrop);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: 'kern' 1, 'tnum' 1;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
i, em, cite { font-style: normal; }
img { display: block; }

.page {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 34px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* —— masthead: ears + blackletter + dateline bar —— */
.mast {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 26px 0 18px;
}
.ear {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 7px 11px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 185px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.ear.right { justify-self: end; text-align: right; }
.mast-c { text-align: center; display: block; }
.mast-c .english {
  font-family: var(--blackletter);
  font-size: 54px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.mast-c .chinese {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
  letter-spacing: 0.85em;
  padding-left: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.dateline {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.dateline::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dateline .in {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  padding: 6px 2px;
}

/* —— nav —— */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark); }
.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.nav a { padding: 8px 13px; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a.is-active { background: var(--dark); color: var(--paper); }

/* —— back rail (inner pages) —— */
.back-rail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.back-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— post-game 快讯 strip (index.end variant) —— */
.breaking {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 11px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.breaking-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  flex: none;
}
.breaking a { min-width: 0; }
.breaking-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.breaking a:hover .breaking-title { color: var(--sub); }
.breaking-time { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

/* —— new-edition sash (act2 front page, until dismissed) ——
   A cinnabar wrap band across the cover, full-bleed against the page borders.
   The one big solid block in a sheet of hairlines. 知道了 folds the band up
   and emits the seen fact. */
.sash-slot {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 -34px;
  max-height: 130px;
  transition: max-height .45s ease;
}
.sash-slot[hidden] { display: none; }
.sash-slot.folded { max-height: 0; }
.sash {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 16px 30px 20px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(253, 252, 249, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(100deg, #9c3226 0%, var(--stamp) 45%, #b23e30 100%);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 19, 18, 0.25);
  transform-origin: 12% 100%;
  animation: sash-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes sash-in {
  from { transform: translateX(-30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
}
.sash::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -7px;
  height: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0);
  background-size: 14px 8px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}
.sash-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: .25em;
  border: 2px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.85);
  padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px;
}
.sash-text {
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sash-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12.5px var(--sans);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.7);
  padding: 5px 16px;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.sash-close:hover { background: #fdf7ee; color: var(--stamp); }

/* —— cover package —— */
.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  padding: 26px 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.cover-main { padding-right: 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.deck-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.deck-hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-top: 10px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.deck-hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.deck-sub {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 42em;
}
.deck-by { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 336px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: start;
}
.cover-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.cover-body p { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cover-body p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 2.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 3px 7px 0 0;
}
.cont {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: right;
}
a.cont:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.cover-fig .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.cover-fig .caption { text-align: right; }

/* —— cover rail —— */
.cover-rail { padding-left: 24px; }
.rail-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding: 7px 0 7px 0.45em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.brief { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.brief li { padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.brief li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.brief .lbl {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}
.brief .txt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }
.mr { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.mr li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.mr li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.mr .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 20px; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1.1; }
.mr .t { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
.mr .t a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.mkt table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.mkt td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.mkt tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.mkt .d { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.mkt .up { color: var(--up); }
.mkt .down { color: var(--down); }

/* —— featured row —— */
.feat {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  column-gap: 41px;
  padding: 22px 0;
}
.feat article { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.feat article:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.feat .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.feat .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: 13px;
}
.feat .hed a:hover, .feat a:hover .hed { color: var(--sub); }
.feat .center-rule { width: 34px; height: 1px; background: var(--ink); margin: 9px auto; }
.feat .txt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.feat .src { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; }

/* —— lower split: section stacks + rail —— */
.lower {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
}
.lower-main { padding: 0 26px 8px 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.lower-rail { padding: 0 0 8px 24px; }

.sec { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.sec:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sec-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.55em;
  padding: 0 0 9px 0.55em;
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
}
.sec-h a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 150px;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.row.no-art { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.row-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
a:hover .row-title { color: var(--sub); }
.row-excerpt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.thumb { display: block; }
.thumb .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }

/* —— lower rail blocks —— */
.rail-blk { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.rail-blk:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.rail-blk .rail-h { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.wx table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.wx td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.wx tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.wx .c { color: var(--meta); }
.wx .t { text-align: right; }

/* boxed print ads (sponsored + Pulse) */
.ad-box { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 14px 14px 16px; }
.ad-box:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-tag {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.ad-box .photo-frame { margin-bottom: 11px; background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-hed {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 7px;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-cta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 9px;
  border-top: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.pulse-logo {
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.pulse-trends { list-style: none; margin-top: 10px; }
.pulse-trends li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.pulse-trends li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.pulse-trends .t-rank { color: var(--meta); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pulse-trends .t-count { color: var(--meta); font-size: 11px; }

/* —— series box —— */
.series-box { border: 3px double var(--dark); margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 18px 24px 22px; }
.series-box .h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.series-box .sub { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.series-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.series-cols article { padding: 0 18px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.series-cols article:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.series-cols article:last-child { border-right: 0; padding-right: 0; }
.series-cols .n { text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.series-cols .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.series-cols .hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.series-cols .ex {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 8px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}

/* —— page index + footer —— */
.idx {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  margin-top: 24px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px 0;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.idx a { padding: 0 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.idx a:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.idx a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

.foot {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  padding: 16px 0 30px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.foot a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— photo —— */
.photo { margin: 0; }
.photo-frame {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.photo-frame img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  filter: saturate(0.82) contrast(1.04);
}
.photo-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.photo-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.photo-3x2 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.photo-square { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.photo-3x4 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }
.caption {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  padding-top: 7px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* no-image fallback frame */
.ph {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.ph .ph-mark { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); }
.ph-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.ph-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.ph-3x2 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.ph-square { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.ph-3x4 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }

/* —— article page —— */
.article-page main,
.static-page main {
  padding: 30px 0 36px;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
}
.article-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.article-headline {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 38px);
  line-height: 1.35;
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.article-standfirst {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 40em;
}
.article-byline {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  margin: 14px 0 22px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}
.article-byline a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.article-art { margin: 0 0 22px; }
.article-art .caption { text-align: right; }
.article-body p {
  font-family: var(--serif);

}
.pull-quote {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);

  padding: 20px 24px;

}
.article-foot-meta {
  margin-top: 26px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
}
.tag-pill { border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 1px 8px; color: var(--sub); }

/* related strip */
.related-strip { border-top: 2px solid var(--dark); padding: 20px 0 26px; }
.related-strip h2 {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding-left: 0.45em;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); column-gap: 41px; }
.related-card { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.related-card:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.related-card .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.related-thumb { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.related-card .lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 5px; }
.related-card .ttl {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}
.related-card:hover .ttl { color: var(--sub); }
.related-card .ex {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 0;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* —— reader comments —— */
.comments { margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 3px double var(--dark); }
.comments-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
}
.comments-head h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }
.comments-head .count { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }
.comment-list { list-style: none; }
.comment {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 13px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
  align-items: start;
}
.comment:last-of-type { border-bottom: 0; }
.comment.is-pinned { border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 15px 15px; margin: 8px 0; }
.comment.is-skeptic { opacity: 0.6; }
.comment-avatar {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
}
.comment-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.comment-name { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.5px; }
.comment-handle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--meta); }
.comment-handle:hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.comment-flag {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 0 6px;
}
.comment-time { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-left: auto; }
.comment-body { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.comment-actions { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--sub); }
.comment-actions button.vote { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.comment-actions .vote { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.comment-actions .vote.up { color: var(--up); }
.comment-actions .vote.down { color: var(--down); }
.comment-actions .vote.down.muted { color: #b9b2a4; }
.comment-actions .vote:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.comment-actions .vote.is-mine { font-weight: 700; }
.comment-collapsed { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-left: 12px; }
.comments-pulse { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 13px 16px; margin-top: 18px; text-align: center; }
.comments-pulse:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.comments-pulse .cp-tag {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--meta);
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.comments-pulse .cp-line { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.5; }

/* —— section page —— */
.section-header {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 34px 0 20px;
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
}
.section-header .section-mark { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); letter-spacing: 0.3em; padding-left: 0.3em; }
.section-h1 {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4.4vw, 46px);
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 10px 0 8px;
}
.section-desc { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); margin: 0 0 6px; }
.section-count { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

.section-list { list-style: none; }
.section-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0, 1fr) 220px;
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: start;
  padding: 24px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.section-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.section-row-num { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 400; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1; }
.section-row-title { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; margin: 0 0 8px; }
a:hover .section-row-title { color: var(--sub); }
.section-row-ex { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--sub); margin: 0 0 10px; }
.section-row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.section-row-art .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }

.section-empty { padding: 56px 0 64px; text-align: center; }
.section-empty .empty-stamp {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 26px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  padding-left: 0.2em;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
  padding-top: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 250px;
}
.section-empty .empty-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 0 auto 18px;
  max-width: 32em;
}
.section-empty .empty-meta { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--meta); margin: 0; }
.section-empty .empty-meta a { color: var(--sub); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.section-empty .empty-meta a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— static pages (about / contact / sponsor) —— */
.static-section { margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.static-section h2 {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding-left: 0.45em;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}
.static-section p {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.static-section p.small { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); text-align: left; }
.static-page .article-body p.lede { text-align: justify; }
.masthead-dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
  gap: 8px 20px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}
.masthead-dl dt { color: var(--meta); text-align: right; }
.masthead-dl dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); }

.sponsor-banner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.sponsor-banner .sponsor-tag {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 0 8px;
}
.sponsor-cta-line {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
  padding: 14px 0 !important;
  margin: 18px 0 !important;
}
.sponsor-fine {
  font-family: var(--sans) !important;
  color: var(--meta) !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  line-height: 1.7 !important;
  text-align: left !important;
}

/* —— small screens (the in-game browser can be narrow) —— */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .page { padding: 0 16px; }
  .mast { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .ear { display: none; }
  .cover { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cover-main { padding-right: 0; border-right: 0; }
  .cover-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cover-rail { padding-left: 0; margin-top: 22px; }
  .feat { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; row-gap: 20px; }
  .feat article { padding: 0 14px 0 0; border-right: 0; }
  .lower { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .lower-main { border-right: 0; padding-right: 0; }
  .lower-rail { padding-left: 0; }
  .series-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .series-cols article { padding: 10px 0; border-right: 0; }
  .row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .row .thumb { max-width: 220px; }
  .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .related-card { padding: 12px 0; border-right: 0; }
  .section-row { grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .section-row-art { display: none; }
  .comment-time { margin-left: 0; }
}
</style>
</head>

容纳的信息，不止于我们这个宇宙曾经发生过的事。」CEO 在会上表示，「它以同等的真实程度，容纳了所有逻辑上可能存在的世界的信息。每一个不同的选择，都造就一条不同的世界线；每一个未发生的事件，都在 AlephPro 中作为岔路被完整记载。」</p></div><div><p>据称，CEO 在此处向在场投资人抛出了一个问题，「信息的真实存在，是否就意味着那些世界的真实存在？如果答案是肯定的，那么诸位，我们谈论的就不再是一款计算产品。我们谈论的将会是人类史上第一次对平行世界的抵达。」</p></div><div><p>一位要求匿名的参会者称，会议的最后十分钟「已经不是在向投资人介绍产品了」。据其转述，CEO class="pull-quote">「AlephPro 是属于我们这一代人的航行。弗图姆邀请诸位合作伙伴前来登船。」</blockquote></div><div><p>「当时所有人都起立鼓掌，有人都激动得哭出声了。」上述参会者回忆道，「 我从业二十多年，没见过这种场面。那天晚上我们都觉得见证了历史。」</p></div><div><p>会后一周内，已有超过 10 家公司与机构就 <style>/*
 * The Meridian Post — 合刊 (broadsheet editorial)
 *
 * A flat printed sheet: blackletter English masthead over spaced 子午线邮报,
 * masthead ears, a double-rule dateline bar, centered multi-deck cover story,

 */

:root {
  --ink: #141312;
  --sub: #55524c;
  --meta: #797469;
  --rule: #ddd8cd;
  --dark: #141312;
  --paper: #fdfcf9;
  --paper-2: #f4f1ea;
  --backdrop: #f2f0ea;
  --stamp: #a8362a;
  --up: #2f6b34;
  --down: #a8362a;

  --serif: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', 'SimSun', serif;
  --sans: 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --blackletter: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--backdrop);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: 'kern' 1, 'tnum' 1;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
i, em, cite { font-style: normal; }
img { display: block; }

.page {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 34px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* —— masthead: ears + blackletter + dateline bar —— */
.mast {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 26px 0 18px;
}
.ear {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 7px 11px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 185px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.ear.right { justify-self: end; text-align: right; }
.mast-c { text-align: center; display: block; }
.mast-c .english {
  font-family: var(--blackletter);
  font-size: 54px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.mast-c .chinese {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
  letter-spacing: 0.85em;
  padding-left: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.dateline {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.dateline::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dateline .in {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  padding: 6px 2px;
}

/* —— nav —— */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark); }
.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.nav a { padding: 8px 13px; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a.is-active { background: var(--dark); color: var(--paper); }

/* —— back rail (inner pages) —— */
.back-rail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.back-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— post-game 快讯 strip (index.end variant) —— */
.breaking {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 11px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.breaking-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  flex: none;
}
.breaking a { min-width: 0; }
.breaking-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.breaking a:hover .breaking-title { color: var(--sub); }
.breaking-time { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

/* —— new-edition sash (act2 front page, until dismissed) ——
   A cinnabar wrap band across the cover, full-bleed against the page borders.
   The one big solid block in a sheet of hairlines. 知道了 folds the band up
   and emits the seen fact. */
.sash-slot {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 -34px;
  max-height: 130px;
  transition: max-height .45s ease;
}
.sash-slot[hidden] { display: none; }
.sash-slot.folded { max-height: 0; }
.sash {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 16px 30px 20px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(253, 252, 249, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(100deg, #9c3226 0%, var(--stamp) 45%, #b23e30 100%);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 19, 18, 0.25);
  transform-origin: 12% 100%;
  animation: sash-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes sash-in {
  from { transform: translateX(-30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
}
.sash::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -7px;
  height: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0);
  background-size: 14px 8px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}
.sash-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: .25em;
  border: 2px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.85);
  padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px;
}
.sash-text {
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sash-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12.5px var(--sans);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.7);
  padding: 5px 16px;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.sash-close:hover { background: #fdf7ee; color: var(--stamp); }

/* —— cover package —— */
.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  padding: 26px 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.cover-main { padding-right: 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.deck-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.deck-hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-top: 10px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.deck-hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.deck-sub {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 42em;
}
.deck-by { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 336px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: start;
}
.cover-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.cover-body p { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cover-body p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 2.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 3px 7px 0 0;
}
.cont {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: right;
}
a.cont:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.cover-fig .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.cover-fig .caption { text-align: right; }

/* —— cover rail —— */
.cover-rail { padding-left: 24px; }
.rail-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding: 7px 0 7px 0.45em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.brief { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.brief li { padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.brief li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.brief .lbl {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}
.brief .txt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }
.mr { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.mr li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.mr li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.mr .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 20px; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1.1; }
.mr .t { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
.mr .t a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.mkt table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.mkt td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.mkt tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.mkt .d { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.mkt .up { color: var(--up); }
.mkt .down { color: var(--down); }

/* —— featured row —— */
.feat {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  column-gap: 41px;
  padding: 22px 0;
}
.feat article { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.feat article:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.feat .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.feat .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: 13px;
}
.feat .hed a:hover, .feat a:hover .hed { color: var(--sub); }
.feat .center-rule { width: 34px; height: 1px; background: var(--ink); margin: 9px auto; }
.feat .txt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.feat .src { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; }

/* —— lower split: section stacks + rail —— */
.lower {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
}
.lower-main { padding: 0 26px 8px 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.lower-rail { padding: 0 0 8px 24px; }

.sec { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.sec:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sec-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.55em;
  padding: 0 0 9px 0.55em;
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
}
.sec-h a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 150px;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.row.no-art { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.row-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
a:hover .row-title { color: var(--sub); }
.row-excerpt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.thumb { display: block; }
.thumb .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }

/* —— lower rail blocks —— */
.rail-blk { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.rail-blk:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.rail-blk .rail-h { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.wx table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.wx td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.wx tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.wx .c { color: var(--meta); }
.wx .t { text-align: right; }

/* boxed print ads (sponsored + Pulse) */
.ad-box { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 14px 14px 16px; }
.ad-box:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-tag {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.ad-box .photo-frame { margin-bottom: 11px; background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-hed {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 7px;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-cta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 9px;
  border-top: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.pulse-logo {
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.pulse-trends { list-style: none; margin-top: 10px; }
.pulse-trends li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.pulse-trends li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.pulse-trends .t-rank { color: var(--meta); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pulse-trends .t-count { color: var(--meta); font-size: 11px; }

/* —— series box —— */
.series-box { border: 3px double var(--dark); margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 18px 24px 22px; }
.series-box .h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.series-box .sub { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.series-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.series-cols article { padding: 0 18px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.series-cols article:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.series-cols article:last-child { border-right: 0; padding-right: 0; }
.series-cols .n { text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.series-cols .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.series-cols .hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.series-cols .ex {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 8px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}

/* —— page index + footer —— */
.idx {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  margin-top: 24px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px 0;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.idx a { padding: 0 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.idx a:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.idx a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

.foot {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  padding: 16px 0 30px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.foot a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— photo —— */
.photo { margin: 0; }
.photo-frame {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.photo-frame img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  filter: saturate(0.82) contrast(1.04);
}
.photo-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.photo-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.photo-3x2 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.photo-square { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.photo-3x4 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }
.caption {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  padding-top: 7px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* no-image fallback frame */
.ph {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.ph .ph-mark { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); }
.ph-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.ph-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.ph-3x2 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.ph-square { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.ph-3x4 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }

/* —— article page —— */
.article-page main,
.static-page main {
  padding: 30px 0 36px;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
}
.article-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.article-headline {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 38px);
  line-height: 1.35;
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.article-standfirst {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 40em;
}
.article-byline {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  margin: 14px 0 22px;

  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}
.article-byline a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.article-art { margin: 0 0 22px; }
.article-art .caption { text-align: right; }
.article-body p {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.95;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.article-body > div:first-child > p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 3em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 4px 8px 0 0;
}
.pull-quote {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin: 26px 0;
}
.article-foot-meta {
  margin-top: 26px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
}
.tag-pill { border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 1px 8px; color: var(--sub); }

/* related strip */
.related-strip { border-top: 2px solid var(--dark); padding: 20px 0 26px; }
.related-strip h2 {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding-left: 0.45em;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); column-gap: 41px; }
.related-card { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.related-card:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.related-card .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.related-thumb { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.related-card .lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 5px; }
.related-card .ttl {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}
.related-card:hover .ttl { color: var(--sub); }
.related-card .ex {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 0;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* —— reader comments —— */
.comments { margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 3px double var(--dark); }
.comments-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
}
.comments-head h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }
.comments-head .count { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }
.comment-list { list-style: none; }
.comment {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 13px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
  align-items: start;
}
.comment:last-of-type { border-bottom: 0; }
.comment.is-pinned { border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 15px 15px; margin: 8px 0; }
.comment.is-skeptic { opacity: 0.6; }
.comment-avatar {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
}
.comment-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.comment-name { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.5px; }
.comment-handle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--meta); }
.comment-handle:hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.comment-flag {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 0 6px;
}
.comment-time { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-left: auto; }
.comment-body { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.comment-actions { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--sub); }
.comment-actions button.vote { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.comment-actions .vote { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.comment-actions .vote.down { color: var(--down); }

.comment-actions .vote.is-mine { font-weight: 700; }
.comment-collapsed { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-left: 12px; }
.comments-pulse { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 13px 16px; margin-top: 18px; text-align: center; }
.comments-pulse:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.comments-pulse .cp-tag {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--meta);
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;

人已被宣告脑死亡。已有病例在活动范围、生活习惯、年龄性别、职业收入等方面无显著共同点，最小的一位年仅八岁，事件原因正在调查中。</p></div><div><p>疾控中心已派出工作组进行调查，调查方向涵盖化学物质泄露、环境污染、新型病毒、集体精神癔症等多个方面，但都未能取得明确结论。目前为止，昏迷事件的原因与规律仍然未知。</p></div><div><p>当前昏迷患者已在考德伍德制药支持下入院治疗，并享医疗监控服务。郡总医院神经科医生透露，患者昏迷后脑部神经活动出现了异常紊乱与爆发性放电，并在神经活跃程度抵达峰值后急剧衰减，直至意识反应消失，这一病程与任何已知疾病都并不相符。</p><blockquote <style>/*
