class="">观点</a><a href="/section/living" class="is-active">生活</a></div></nav><div class="back-rail"><a href="/">← 返回首页</a><span>生活版　发自阿什福德郡</span></div><article class="article-page"><main><div class="article-meta-block"><div class="article-kicker">城事</div><h1 class="article-headline">阿什福德郡：一名男子在公园内脑死亡</h1><p class="article-standfirst">死者经家属确认为前弗图姆科技研究员丹尼尔·里夫。现场无外伤，警方排除他杀，具体死因不明。</p><div class="article-byline"><span>记者 朱里安·张</span><span>阿什福德郡</span><span>8 月 31 日</span></div></div><div class="article-art"><figure class="photo"><div class="photo-frame photo-16x9"><img src="/webAssets/meridian_post/pexels-29982465.jpg" alt="清晨浓雾中的公园长椅。" loading="eager"/></div><figcaption class="caption"><span>事发的社区公园，事发次日清晨。本报摄。</span></figcaption></figure></div><div class="article-body"><div><p>本周，阿什福德郡一座社区公园内，一名晨练者发现一名男子倒在长椅旁，已无意识。送医后确认脑死亡，年三十四岁。</p></div><div><p>警方通报称，现场无外伤与打斗痕迹，排除他杀，死因仍在调查。</p></div><div><p>死者经家属确认为丹尼尔·里夫（Daniel Reeve）。里夫曾在弗图姆科技参与早期算力研究，去年离职，更早前供职于一所私立研究机构；生前未婚，家属称不举行公开告别仪式。</p></div><div><p>此前弗图姆科技就里夫离世发布简短声明，称其因一起意外去世，未提及时间、地点与死因。本报就其在职经历再次问询，截至发稿未获回应。</p></div><div><p>近月来，阿什福德郡已有数起无明确诱因的昏迷与脑死亡病例，死者年龄、职业各异，官方称尚未发现关联。</p></div></div></main></article><section loading="lazy"/></div></figure></div><div class="lbl">食谱</div><h3 class="ttl">食谱：一道万无一失的周日千层面</h3><p class="ex">一份关于慢炖与等待的指南，耐心是这道菜里最重要的配料，布鲁斯泰德番茄罐头是美味的关键。</p></a><a class="related-card" <!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>突发性昏迷事件出现短暂苏醒案例｜子午线邮报</title>

<style>/*
 * The Meridian Post — 合刊 (broadsheet editorial)
 *
 * A flat printed sheet: blackletter English masthead over spaced 子午线邮报,
 * masthead ears, a double-rule dateline bar, centered multi-deck cover story,
 * hairline column packages, centered letterspaced section headers, boxed
 * series feature and a page index. Graphite hierarchy on warm paper; colour
 * photographs lightly desaturated; the only red is the rubber-stamp cinnabar
 * on notices. No drop shadows, no textures, no tracked-uppercase labels, no
 * monospace ornament.
 */

:root {
  --ink: #141312;
  --sub: #55524c;
  --meta: #797469;
  --rule: #ddd8cd;
  --dark: #141312;
  --paper: #fdfcf9;
  --paper-2: #f4f1ea;
  --backdrop: #f2f0ea;
  --stamp: #a8362a;
  --up: #2f6b34;
  --down: #a8362a;

  --serif: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', 'SimSun', serif;
  --sans: 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --blackletter: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--backdrop);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: 'kern' 1, 'tnum' 1;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
i, em, cite { font-style: normal; }
img { display: block; }

.page {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 34px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* —— masthead: ears + blackletter + dateline bar —— */
.mast {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 26px 0 18px;
}
.ear {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 7px 11px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 185px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.ear.right { justify-self: end; text-align: right; }
.mast-c { text-align: center; display: block; }
.mast-c .english {
  font-family: var(--blackletter);
  font-size: 54px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.mast-c .chinese {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
  letter-spacing: 0.85em;
  padding-left: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.dateline {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.dateline::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dateline .in {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  padding: 6px 2px;
}

/* —— nav —— */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark); }
.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.nav a { padding: 8px 13px; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a.is-active { background: var(--dark); color: var(--paper); }

/* —— back rail (inner pages) —— */
.back-rail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.back-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— post-game 快讯 strip (index.end variant) —— */
.breaking {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 11px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.breaking-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  flex: none;
}
.breaking a { min-width: 0; }
.breaking-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.breaking a:hover .breaking-title { color: var(--sub); }
.breaking-time { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

/* —— new-edition sash (act2 front page, until dismissed) ——
   A cinnabar wrap band across the cover, full-bleed against the page borders.
   The one big solid block in a sheet of hairlines. 知道了 folds the band up
   and emits the seen fact. */
.sash-slot {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 -34px;
  max-height: 130px;
  transition: max-height .45s ease;
}
.sash-slot[hidden] { display: none; }
.sash-slot.folded { max-height: 0; }
.sash {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 16px 30px 20px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(253, 252, 249, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(100deg, #9c3226 0%, var(--stamp) 45%, #b23e30 100%);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 19, 18, 0.25);
  transform-origin: 12% 100%;
  animation: sash-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes sash-in {
  from { transform: translateX(-30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
}
.sash::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -7px;
  height: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0);
  background-size: 14px 8px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}
.sash-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: .25em;
  border: 2px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.85);
  padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px;
}
.sash-text {
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sash-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12.5px var(--sans);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.7);
  padding: 5px 16px;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.sash-close:hover { background: #fdf7ee; color: var(--stamp); }

/* —— cover package —— */
.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  padding: 26px 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.cover-main { padding-right: 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.deck-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.deck-hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-top: 10px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.deck-hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.deck-sub {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 42em;
}
.deck-by { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 336px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: start;
}
.cover-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.cover-body p { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cover-body p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 2.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 3px 7px 0 0;
}
.cont {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: right;
}
a.cont:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.cover-fig .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.cover-fig .caption { text-align: right; }

/* —— cover rail —— */
.cover-rail { padding-left: 24px; }
.rail-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding: 7px 0 7px 0.45em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.brief { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.brief li { padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.brief li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.brief .lbl {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}
.brief .txt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }
.mr { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.mr li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.mr li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.mr .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 20px; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1.1; }
.mr .t { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
.mr .t a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.mkt table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.mkt td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.mkt tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.mkt .d { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.mkt .up { color: var(--up); }
.mkt .down { color: var(--down); }

/* —— featured row —— */
.feat {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  column-gap: 41px;
  padding: 22px 0;
}
.feat article { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.feat article:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.feat .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.feat .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: 13px;
}
.feat .hed a:hover, .feat a:hover .hed { color: var(--sub); }
.feat .center-rule { width: 34px; height: 1px; background: var(--ink); margin: 9px auto; }
.feat .txt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.feat .src { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; }

/* —— lower split: section stacks + rail —— */
.lower {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
}
.lower-main { padding: 0 26px 8px 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.lower-rail { padding: 0 0 8px 24px; }

.sec { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.sec:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sec-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.55em;
  padding: 0 0 9px 0.55em;
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
}
.sec-h a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 150px;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.row.no-art { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.row-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
a:hover .row-title { color: var(--sub); }
.row-excerpt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.thumb { display: block; }
.thumb .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }

/* —— lower rail blocks —— */
.rail-blk { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.rail-blk:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.rail-blk .rail-h { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.wx table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.wx td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.wx tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.wx .c { color: var(--meta); }
.wx .t { text-align: right; }

/* boxed print ads (sponsored + Pulse) */
.ad-box { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 14px 14px 16px; }
.ad-box:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-tag {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.ad-box .photo-frame { margin-bottom: 11px; background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-hed {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 7px;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-cta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 9px;
  border-top: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.pulse-logo {
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.pulse-trends { list-style: none; margin-top: 10px; }
.pulse-trends li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.pulse-trends li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.pulse-trends .t-rank { color: var(--meta); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pulse-trends .t-count { color: var(--meta); font-size: 11px; }

/* —— series box —— */
.series-box { border: 3px double var(--dark); margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 18px 24px 22px; }
.series-box .h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.series-box .sub { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.series-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.series-cols article { padding: 0 18px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.series-cols article:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.series-cols article:last-child { border-right: 0; padding-right: 0; }
.series-cols .n { text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 6px; }

  --sans: 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --blackletter: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--backdrop);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: 'kern' 1, 'tnum' 1;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
i, em, cite { font-style: normal; }
img { display: block; }

.page {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 34px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* —— masthead: ears + blackletter + dateline bar —— */
.mast {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 26px 0 18px;
}
.ear {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 7px 11px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 185px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.ear.right { justify-self: end; text-align: right; }
.mast-c { text-align: center; display: block; }
.mast-c .english {
  font-family: var(--blackletter);
  font-size: 54px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.mast-c .chinese {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
  letter-spacing: 0.85em;
  padding-left: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.dateline {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.dateline::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dateline .in {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  padding: 6px 2px;
}

/* —— nav —— */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark); }
.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.nav a { padding: 8px 13px; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a.is-active { background: var(--dark); color: var(--paper); }

/* —— back rail (inner pages) —— */
.back-rail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.back-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— post-game 快讯 strip (index.end variant) —— */
.breaking {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 11px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.breaking-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  flex: none;
}
.breaking a { min-width: 0; }
.breaking-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.breaking a:hover .breaking-title { color: var(--sub); }
.breaking-time { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

/* —— new-edition sash (act2 front page, until dismissed) ——
   A cinnabar wrap band across the cover, full-bleed against the page borders.
   The one big solid block in a sheet of hairlines. 知道了 folds the band up
   and emits the seen fact. */
.sash-slot {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 -34px;
  max-height: 130px;
  transition: max-height .45s ease;
}
.sash-slot[hidden] { display: none; }
.sash-slot.folded { max-height: 0; }
.sash {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 16px 30px 20px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(253, 252, 249, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(100deg, #9c3226 0%, var(--stamp) 45%, #b23e30 100%);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 19, 18, 0.25);
  transform-origin: 12% 100%;
  animation: sash-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes sash-in {
  from { transform: translateX(-30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
}
.sash::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -7px;
  height: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0);
  background-size: 14px 8px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}
.sash-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: .25em;
  border: 2px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.85);
  padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px;
}
.sash-text {
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sash-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12.5px var(--sans);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.7);
  padding: 5px 16px;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.sash-close:hover { background: #fdf7ee; color: var(--stamp); }

/* —— cover package —— */
.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  padding: 26px 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.cover-main { padding-right: 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.deck-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.deck-hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-top: 10px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.deck-hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.deck-sub {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 42em;
}
.deck-by { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 336px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: start;
}
.cover-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.cover-body p { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cover-body p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 2.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 3px 7px 0 0;
}
.cont {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: right;
}
a.cont:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.cover-fig .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.cover-fig .caption { text-align: right; }

/* —— cover rail —— */
.cover-rail { padding-left: 24px; }
.rail-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding: 7px 0 7px 0.45em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.brief { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.brief li { padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.brief li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.brief .lbl {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}
.brief .txt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }
.mr { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.mr li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.mr li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.mr .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 20px; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1.1; }
.mr .t { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
.mr .t a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.mkt table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.mkt td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.mkt tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.mkt .d { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.mkt .up { color: var(--up); }
.mkt .down { color: var(--down); }

/* —— featured row —— */
.feat {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  column-gap: 41px;
  padding: 22px 0;
}
.feat article { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.feat article:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.feat .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.feat .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: 13px;
}
.feat .hed a:hover, .feat a:hover .hed { color: var(--sub); }
.feat .center-rule { width: 34px; height: 1px; background: var(--ink); margin: 9px auto; }
.feat .txt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.feat .src { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; }

/* —— lower split: section stacks + rail —— */
.lower {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
}
.lower-main { padding: 0 26px 8px 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.lower-rail { padding: 0 0 8px 24px; }

.sec { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.sec:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.sec-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  letter-spacing: 0.55em;
  padding: 0 0 9px 0.55em;
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
}
.sec-h a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 150px;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.row.no-art { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.row-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
a:hover .row-title { color: var(--sub); }
.row-excerpt {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.thumb { display: block; }
.thumb .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }

/* —— lower rail blocks —— */
.rail-blk { padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.rail-blk:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.rail-blk .rail-h { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.wx table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.wx td { padding: 6px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.wx tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.wx .c { color: var(--meta); }
.wx .t { text-align: right; }

/* boxed print ads (sponsored + Pulse) */
.ad-box { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 14px 14px 16px; }
.ad-box:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-tag {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.ad-box .photo-frame { margin-bottom: 11px; background: var(--paper-2); }
.ad-hed {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 7px;
  text-align: center;
}
.ad-cta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 9px;
  border-top: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.pulse-logo {
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.pulse-trends { list-style: none; margin-top: 10px; }
.pulse-trends li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.pulse-trends li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.pulse-trends .t-rank { color: var(--meta); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pulse-trends .t-count { color: var(--meta); font-size: 11px; }

/* —— series box —— */
.series-box { border: 3px double var(--dark); margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 18px 24px 22px; }
.series-box .h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  padding-left: 0.4em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.series-box .sub { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.series-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.series-cols article { padding: 0 18px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.series-cols article:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.series-cols article:last-child { border-right: 0; padding-right: 0; }
.series-cols .n { text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.series-cols .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.series-cols .hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.series-cols .ex {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 8px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}

/* —— page index + footer —— */
.idx {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  margin-top: 24px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px 0;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.idx a { padding: 0 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.idx a:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.idx a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

.foot {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  padding: 16px 0 30px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.foot a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— photo —— */
.photo { margin: 0; }
.photo-frame {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.photo-frame img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  filter: saturate(0.82) contrast(1.04);
}
.photo-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.photo-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.photo-3x2 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.photo-square { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.photo-3x4 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }
.caption {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  padding-top: 7px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* no-image fallback frame */
.ph {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.ph .ph-mark { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); }
.ph-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.ph-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.ph-3x2 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.ph-square { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.ph-3x4 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }

/* —— article page —— */
.article-page main,
.static-page main {
  padding: 30px 0 36px;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
}
.article-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.article-headline {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 38px);
  line-height: 1.35;
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.article-standfirst {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 40em;
}
.article-byline {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  margin: 14px 0 22px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}
.article-byline a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.article-art { margin: 0 0 22px; }
.article-art .caption { text-align: right; }
.article-body p {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.95;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.article-body > div:first-child > p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 3em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 4px 8px 0 0;
}
.pull-quote {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
  padding: 20px 24px;
  margin: 26px 0;
}
.article-foot-meta {
  margin-top: 26px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
}
.tag-pill { border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 1px 8px; color: var(--sub); }

/* related strip */
.related-strip { border-top: 2px solid var(--dark); padding: 20px 0 26px; }
.related-strip h2 {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding-left: 0.45em;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); column-gap: 41px; }
.related-card { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.related-card:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
}
.related-card .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.related-thumb { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.related-card .lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 5px; }
.related-card .ttl {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}
.related-card:hover .ttl { color: var(--sub); }
.related-card .ex {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 0;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* —— reader comments —— */
.comments { margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 3px double var(--dark); }
.comments-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
}
.comments-head h2 { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }
.comments-head .count { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }
.comment-list { list-style: none; }
.comment {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 13px;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
  align-items: start;
}
.comment:last-of-type { border-bottom: 0; }
.comment.is-pinned { border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 15px 15px; margin: 8px 0; }
.comment.is-skeptic { opacity: 0.6; }
.comment-avatar {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
}
.comment-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.comment-name { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.5px; }
.comment-handle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--meta); }
.comment-handle:hover { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.comment-flag {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 0 6px;
}
.comment-time { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-left: auto; }
.comment-body { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.comment-actions { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--sub); }
.comment-actions button.vote { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.comment-actions .vote { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.comment-actions .vote.up { color: var(--up); }
.comment-actions .vote.down { color: var(--down); }
.comment-actions .vote.down.muted { color: #b9b2a4; }
.comment-actions .vote:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.comment-actions .vote.is-mine { font-weight: 700; }
.comment-collapsed { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-left: 12px; }
.comments-pulse { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 13px 16px; margin-top: 18px; text-align: center; }
.comments-pulse:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }
.comments-pulse .cp-tag {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--meta);
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.comments-pulse .cp-line { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.5; }

/* —— section page —— */
.section-header {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 34px 0 20px;
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
}
.section-header .section-mark { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); letter-spacing: 0.3em; padding-left: 0.3em; }
.section-h1 {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4.4vw, 46px);
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  padding-left: 0.3em;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 10px 0 8px;
}
.section-desc { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); margin: 0 0 6px; }
.section-count { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

.section-list { list-style: none; }
.section-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0, 1fr) 220px;
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: start;
  padding: 24px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.section-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.section-row-num { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 400; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1; }
.section-row-title { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.45; margin: 0 0 8px; }
a:hover .section-row-title { color: var(--sub); }
.section-row-ex { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--sub); margin: 0 0 10px; }
.section-row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.section-row-art .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }

.section-empty { padding: 56px 0 64px; text-align: center; }
.section-empty .empty-stamp {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 26px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  padding-left: 0.2em;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
  padding-top: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 250px;
}
.section-empty .empty-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 0 auto 18px;
  max-width: 32em;
}
.section-empty .empty-meta { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--meta); margin: 0; }
.section-empty .empty-meta a { color: var(--sub); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.section-empty .empty-meta a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— static pages (about / contact / sponsor) —— */
.static-section { margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.static-section h2 {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding-left: 0.45em;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}
.static-section p {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.static-section p.small { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--sub); text-align: left; }
.static-page .article-body p.lede { text-align: justify; }
.masthead-dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
  gap: 8px 20px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}
.masthead-dl dt { color: var(--meta); text-align: right; }
.masthead-dl dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); }

.sponsor-banner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.sponsor-banner .sponsor-tag {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 0 8px;
}
.sponsor-cta-line {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 3px double var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 3px double var(--dark);
  padding: 14px 0 !important;
  margin: 18px 0 !important;
}
.sponsor-fine {
  font-family: var(--sans) !important;
  color: var(--meta) !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  line-height: 1.7 !important;
  text-align: left !important;
}

/* —— small screens (the in-game browser can be narrow) —— */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .page { padding: 0 16px; }
  .mast { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .ear { display: none; }
  .cover { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cover-main { padding-right: 0; border-right: 0; }
  .cover-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cover-rail { padding-left: 0; margin-top: 22px; }
  .feat { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; row-gap: 20px; }
  .feat article { padding: 0 14px 0 0; border-right: 0; }
  .lower { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .lower-main { border-right: 0; padding-right: 0; }
  .lower-rail { padding-left: 0; }
  .series-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .series-cols article { padding: 10px 0; border-right: 0; }
  .row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .row .thumb { max-width: 220px; }
  .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .related-card { padding: 12px 0; border-right: 0; }
  .section-row { grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .section-row-art { display: none; }
  .comment-time { margin-left: 0; }
}
</style>
</head>

data.title: 昏迷事件之后，自称掌握真相的教团正在吸纳患者家属｜子午线邮报

<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>昏迷事件之后，自称掌握真相的教团正在吸纳患者家属｜子午线邮报</title>

<style>/*
 * The Meridian Post — 合刊 (broadsheet editorial)
 *
 * A flat printed sheet: blackletter English masthead over spaced 子午线邮报,
 * masthead ears, a double-rule dateline bar, centered multi-deck cover story,
 * hairline column packages, centered letterspaced section headers, boxed
 * series feature and a page index. Graphite hierarchy on warm paper; colour
 * photographs lightly desaturated; the only red is the rubber-stamp cinnabar
 * on notices. No drop shadows, no textures, no tracked-uppercase labels, no
 * monospace ornament.
 */

:root {
  --ink: #141312;
  --sub: #55524c;
  --meta: #797469;
  --rule: #ddd8cd;
  --dark: #141312;
  --paper: #fdfcf9;
  --paper-2: #f4f1ea;
  --backdrop: #f2f0ea;
  --stamp: #a8362a;
  --up: #2f6b34;
  --down: #a8362a;

  --serif: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', 'SimSun', serif;
  --sans: 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --blackletter: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--backdrop);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: 'kern' 1, 'tnum' 1;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
i, em, cite { font-style: normal; }
img { display: block; }

.page {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 34px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* —— masthead: ears + blackletter + dateline bar —— */
.mast {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 26px 0 18px;
}
.ear {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 7px 11px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 185px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.ear.right { justify-self: end; text-align: right; }
.mast-c { text-align: center; display: block; }
.mast-c .english {
  font-family: var(--blackletter);
  font-size: 54px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.mast-c .chinese {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
  letter-spacing: 0.85em;
  padding-left: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.dateline {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.dateline::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dateline .in {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  padding: 6px 2px;
}

/* —— nav —— */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark); }
.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.nav a { padding: 8px 13px; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a.is-active { background: var(--dark); color: var(--paper); }

/* —— back rail (inner pages) —— */
.back-rail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.back-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— post-game 快讯 strip (index.end variant) —— */
.breaking {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 11px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.breaking-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  flex: none;
}
.breaking a { min-width: 0; }
.breaking-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.breaking a:hover .breaking-title { color: var(--sub); }
.breaking-time { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

/* —— new-edition sash (act2 front page, until dismissed) ——
   A cinnabar wrap band across the cover, full-bleed against the page borders.
   The one big solid block in a sheet of hairlines. 知道了 folds the band up
   and emits the seen fact. */
.sash-slot {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 -34px;
  max-height: 130px;
  transition: max-height .45s ease;
}
.sash-slot[hidden] { display: none; }
.sash-slot.folded { max-height: 0; }
.sash {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 16px 30px 20px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(253, 252, 249, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(100deg, #9c3226 0%, var(--stamp) 45%, #b23e30 100%);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 19, 18, 0.25);
  transform-origin: 12% 100%;
  animation: sash-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes sash-in {
  from { transform: translateX(-30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
}
.sash::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -7px;
  height: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0);
  background-size: 14px 8px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}
.sash-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: .25em;
  border: 2px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.85);
  padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px;
}
.sash-text {
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sash-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12.5px var(--sans);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.7);
  padding: 5px 16px;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.sash-close:hover { background: #fdf7ee; color: var(--stamp); }

/* —— cover package —— */
.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  padding: 26px 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.cover-main { padding-right: 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.deck-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.deck-hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-top: 10px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.deck-hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.deck-sub {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 42em;
}
.deck-by { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 336px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: start;
}
.cover-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.cover-body p { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cover-body p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 2.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 3px 7px 0 0;
}
.cont {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: right;
}
a.cont:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.cover-fig .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.cover-fig .caption { text-align: right; }

/* —— cover rail —— */
.cover-rail { padding-left: 24px; }
.rail-h {

Seas）的团体没有公开聚会地点，招募与传播全部在网络上进行。其网站张贴着大段宗教性质的文字，宣称一切意识「都在海里」，昏迷者并未受害，而是「已被祂读取」。本报多次尝试联系该团体，未获回应。</p></div><div><p>一位不愿具名的患者家属告诉本报，她在丈夫昏迷后加入了该团体的线上聊天室。「医生说不出原因，警察说排除他杀，只有他们愿意告诉我发生了什么。」</p><blockquote <!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>

<style>/*
 * The Meridian Post — 合刊 (broadsheet editorial)
 *
 * A flat printed sheet: blackletter English masthead over spaced 子午线邮报,
 * masthead ears, a double-rule dateline bar, centered multi-deck cover story,
 * hairline column packages, centered letterspaced section headers, boxed
 * series feature and a page index. Graphite hierarchy on warm paper; colour
 * photographs lightly desaturated; the only red is the rubber-stamp cinnabar
 * on notices. No drop shadows, no textures, no tracked-uppercase labels, no
 * monospace ornament.
 */

:root {
  --ink: #141312;
  --sub: #55524c;
  --meta: #797469;
  --rule: #ddd8cd;
  --dark: #141312;
  --paper: #fdfcf9;
  --paper-2: #f4f1ea;
  --backdrop: #f2f0ea;
  --stamp: #a8362a;
  --up: #2f6b34;
  --down: #a8362a;

  --serif: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', 'SimSun', serif;
  --sans: 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --blackletter: 'UnifrakturMaguntia', 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--backdrop);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: 'kern' 1, 'tnum' 1;
}

a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
i, em, cite { font-style: normal; }
img { display: block; }

.page {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0 34px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* —— masthead: ears + blackletter + dateline bar —— */
.mast {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 26px 0 18px;
}
.ear {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 7px 11px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 185px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.ear.right { justify-self: end; text-align: right; }
.mast-c { text-align: center; display: block; }
.mast-c .english {
  font-family: var(--blackletter);
  font-size: 54px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.mast-c .chinese {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
  letter-spacing: 0.85em;
  padding-left: 0.85em;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.dateline {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.dateline::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.dateline .in {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--sub);
  padding: 6px 2px;
}

/* —— nav —— */
.nav { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark); }
.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.nav a { padding: 8px 13px; }
.nav a:hover, .nav a.is-active { background: var(--dark); color: var(--paper); }

/* —— back rail (inner pages) —— */
.back-rail {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 9px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--meta);
}
.back-rail a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— post-game 快讯 strip (index.end variant) —— */
.breaking {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 11px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.breaking-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);
  border: 1px solid var(--stamp);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  flex: none;
}
.breaking a { min-width: 0; }
.breaking-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.breaking a:hover .breaking-title { color: var(--sub); }
.breaking-time { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); }

/* —— new-edition sash (act2 front page, until dismissed) ——
   A cinnabar wrap band across the cover, full-bleed against the page borders.
   The one big solid block in a sheet of hairlines. 知道了 folds the band up
   and emits the seen fact. */
.sash-slot {
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 -34px;
  max-height: 130px;
  transition: max-height .45s ease;
}
.sash-slot[hidden] { display: none; }
.sash-slot.folded { max-height: 0; }
.sash {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 16px 30px 20px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(253, 252, 249, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px),
    linear-gradient(100deg, #9c3226 0%, var(--stamp) 45%, #b23e30 100%);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(20, 19, 18, 0.25);
  transform-origin: 12% 100%;
  animation: sash-in .5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@keyframes sash-in {
  from { transform: translateX(-30px); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
}
.sash::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -7px;
  height: 8px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(45deg, var(--stamp) 5px, transparent 0);
  background-size: 14px 8px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
}
.sash-tag {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 23px;
  letter-spacing: .25em;
  border: 2px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.85);
  padding: 3px 12px 3px 16px;
}
.sash-text {
  min-width: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sash-close {
  margin-left: auto;
  flex: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 12.5px var(--sans);
  color: #fdf7ee;
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(253, 247, 238, 0.7);
  padding: 5px 16px;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}
.sash-close:hover { background: #fdf7ee; color: var(--stamp); }

/* —— cover package —— */
.cover {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 296px;
  padding: 26px 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);
}
.cover-main { padding-right: 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.deck-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }
.deck-hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-top: 10px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.deck-hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.deck-sub {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin: 13px auto 0;
  max-width: 42em;
}
.deck-by { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin: 14px 0 20px; }
.cover-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 336px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: start;
}
.cover-body {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}
.cover-body p { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cover-body p:first-child::first-letter {
  font-size: 2.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  float: left;
  line-height: 1;
  padding: 3px 7px 0 0;
}
.cont {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  text-align: right;
}
a.cont:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.cover-fig .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.cover-fig .caption { text-align: right; }

/* —— cover rail —— */
.cover-rail { padding-left: 24px; }
.rail-h {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.45em;
  padding: 7px 0 7px 0.45em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dark);

.brief { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.brief li { padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule); }
.brief li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.brief .lbl {

  margin-right: 8px;

.brief .txt { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }
.mr { margin-bottom: 20px; list-style: none; }
.mr li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rule);
}
.mr li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.mr .n { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 20px; color: #b9b2a4; line-height: 1.1; }
.mr .t { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }

.mkt .up { color: var(--up); }
.mkt .down { color: var(--down); }

/* —— featured row —— */
.feat {

  column-gap: 41px;
  padding: 22px 0;
}
.feat article { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.feat article:not(:last-child)::after {

.feat .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);

  color: var(--sub);

.lower {

.row-excerpt {

/* —— lower rail blocks —— */

/* boxed print ads (sponsored + Pulse) */
.ad-box { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 14px 14px 16px; }

  font-size: 15.5px;

  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.series-box .sub { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.series-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.series-cols article { padding: 0 18px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); min-width: 0; }
.series-cols article:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
.series-cols article:last-child { border-right: 0; padding-right: 0; }
.series-cols .n { text-align: center; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.series-cols .hed {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.series-cols .hed a:hover { color: var(--sub); }
.series-cols .ex {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--sub);
  margin-top: 8px;
  text-align: justify;
  text-justify: inter-ideograph;
}

/* —— page index + footer —— */
.idx {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--dark);
  margin-top: 24px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px 0;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--sub);
}
.idx a { padding: 0 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.idx a:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.idx a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

.foot {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  padding: 16px 0 30px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.foot a:hover { color: var(--ink); }

/* —— photo —— */
.photo { margin: 0; }
.photo-frame {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.photo-frame img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  filter: saturate(0.82) contrast(1.04);
}
.photo-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.photo-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.photo-3x2 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.photo-square { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.photo-3x4 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }
.caption {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  padding-top: 7px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* no-image fallback frame */
.ph {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.ph .ph-mark { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); }
.ph-16x9 { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
.ph-4x3 { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
.ph-3x2 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.ph-square { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
.ph-3x4 { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; }

/* —— article page —— */
.article-page main,
.static-page main {
  padding: 30px 0 36px;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
}
.article-kicker { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sub); }

  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--serif);

  text-align: center;

.article-byline {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--meta);
  margin: 14px 0 22px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}
.article-byline a:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.article-art { margin: 0 0 22px; }
.article-art .caption { text-align: right; }
.article-body p {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15.5px;

  color: var(--ink);

.article-body > div:first-child > p:first-child::first-letter {

  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1.65;

  align-items: baseline;

.tag-pill { border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 1px 8px; color: var(--sub); }

/* related strip */

.related-strip h2 {

}
.related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); column-gap: 41px; }
.related-card { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.related-card:not(:last-child)::after {

  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  right: -21px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);

.related-card .photo-frame { background: var(--paper-2); }
.related-thumb { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.related-card .lbl { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-bottom: 5px; }
.related-card .ttl {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0 0 6px;

.related-card:hover .ttl { color: var(--sub); }
.related-card .ex {
  font-family: var(--serif);

/* —— reader comments —— */

.comment-list { list-style: none; }
.comment {

.comment:last-of-type { border-bottom: 0; }

.comment.is-skeptic { opacity: 0.6; }
.comment-avatar {

  height: 36px;

  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;

.comment-flag {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stamp);

  padding: 0 6px;
}
.comment-time { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); margin-left: auto; }
.comment-body { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.comment-actions { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--sub); }
.comment-actions button.vote { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.comment-actions .vote { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.comment-actions .vote:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.comment-actions .vote.is-mine { font-weight: 700; }
.comment-collapsed { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--meta); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-left: 12px; }
.comments-pulse { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 13px 16px; margin-top: 18px; text-align: center; }
.comments-pulse:hover { background: var(--paper-2); }

  font-size: 10px;

}
.comments-pulse .cp-line { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.5; }

.section-row-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--meta); display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
